Title: Analytics Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome Home!

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation.




Build Trusted Data. Empower Every Decision.

As the Analytics Data Specialist, you will champion and deliver enterprise data products that turn raw data into trusted insights, enabling scalable analytics through an Analytics Centre of Excellence. As part of the team that powers enterprise reporting and decision-making, you'll empower every area of the business with trusted data and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. Led by the Manager, Data and Analytics, this opportunity suits a collaborative and detail-oriented professional who enjoys building scalable data solutions, enabling enterprise analytics, and solving complex data challenges.




Ready to make an impact in a new role? Here’s how:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data products within Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystems that deliver trusted, business-ready data for reporting, analytics and decision making.
Develop and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse data architectures, ensuring structured high performing data layers that support enterprise analytics.
Design and optimize business aligned semantic models that enable consistent reporting and analytics.
Develop automated data pipelines and integrated workflows using Fabric Data Factory, notebooks and Azure services to transform and deliver data.
Implement scalable data transformations that standardize how data is curated and modeled for analytics consumption.
Ensure data quality, integrity and reliability through validation, monitoring and cleansing processes across all datasets.
Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver high quality data solutions and enable adoption of enterprise data products.
Support enterprise data governance and master data management practices by applying data standards and lineage tracking.




We’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field; additional analytics certifications are an asset.
A minimum of five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a related analytics role.
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Strong experience with data engineering and analytics languages (PySpark, SQL, Python, R).
Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Azure SQL), PowerShell scripting, and ETL/ELT processes (SSIS).
Experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Experience with automation and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub) to support repeatable deployments.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional and semantic data models, and data governance practices.
Experience delivering end-to-end analytics solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and reporting (Power BI).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed data platforms.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently interact with senior leaders.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Highly adaptable, with a passion for learning and evolving alongside emerging technologies such as Microsoft Fabric and AI.
Experience with data mining, predictive analytics, machine learning, and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) is an asset.
The ability to be onsite three days a week at our corporate office in St. Jacobs, to accommodate our hybrid working model.




How we’ll make you feel at Home

Our Team Members enjoy life at Home with our strong culture of support and inclusion, excellent benefits, and a team that always has your back. You will receive:

The expected starting salary range for this role is $85,800 - $128,600; the final offer will reflect relevant skills and experience.
Eligible for the annual bonus program.
Comprehensive Benefits Program including:
Health, Dental, Vision, Paramedical, Disability coverage, Out of Country Travel Insurance, Life Insurance, Employee Family Assistance Program.
Defined Contribution Pension Plan with Company Match, and choice of contribution level.
Group RRSP.
Discount from our Corporate Retail Store in St. Jacobs.
Home & Auto Insurance discounts.
Competitive vacation time.
Personal and sick time.
Employee Discount Program through Venngo WorkPerks.

We are seeking a Revenue Insights Analyst to own the development, maintenance, and evolution of reporting and analytics across Sales. This role will be the central point of contact for business intelligence, translating stakeholder needs into scalable data models, dashboards, and actionable insights.

You will play a key role in improving revenue visibility, enabling self-serve reporting, and driving data informed decision-making across the organization. Proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities to improve revenue outcomes

Experience working with CRM systems (Salesforce and/or Microsoft Dynamics)

About The Role

Join the Data team, in the Analyst, Business Systems position. The role involves the delivery of data services and products to both internal and external clients through effective systems analysis and design, modeling, programming and data manipulation. The ideal candidate will have solid programming and analytical skills and can also understand client needs and translate this into useful data. This is a challenging and exciting role for someone who is passionate about data and wants to make a difference in the housing sector.

What You’ll Do


Support business-as-usual production of various data products and reports (includes production of static data tables in Excel, Power BI dashboards, and flat files for website applications such as the Housing Market Information Portal).
Perform programming and quantitative analysis services on research or policy issues by accessing internal and external data sources, integrating and reconciling data from alternate sources, analyzing and disseminating results in order to respond to client custom data requests.
Identify where automation could create more efficient data related processes and implementing those efficiencies in end-user systems.
Introduce new and follow existing quality assurance processes to ensure that all disseminated products contain accurate data and are of high quality.
Maintain definitions and descriptions of data produced, stored and used by Data Division; ensure good process documentation.
Assist with Data Division technology and data transformation projects: this involves migrating large data sets from legacy systems (Mainframe, SAS datasets) to Azure Databricks platform as well as modernizing and automating data ingestion, processing, quality assurance and dissemination.
Assist in transforming legacy SAS code to other programming languages and data processing frameworks, including Python and PySpark.


What You Should Have


An undergraduate degree in a quantitative discipline: computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, data analysis/science, engineering, or related quantitative field.
A minimum 3 years of relevant programming and quantitative analysis experience.
Advanced skills in Excel.
Intermediate to advanced programming skills in Python, including Pandas and NumPy.
Intermediate to advanced skills in SQL: ability to write complex queries, including JOINs and subqueries.
The ability to work with Apache Spark and/or PySpark.
Familiar with Azure Databricks and Azure DevOps.
Collaborative team player with strong customer service, interpersonal and written/verbal communication skills.


It Would Be Great If You Also Had


Intermediate to advanced skills in SAS (experience working with SAS statistical software suite to perform programming tasks is considered an asset).
Working knowledge of AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Databricks Genie) to support data analysis, code development, reporting, and operational efficiency.
Some project management experience/exposure acquired through being a subject matter expert on small to medium-sized technology projects.
A master’s degree in the above disciplines is considered an asset.

The Alberta Public Service works to build a stronger province for current and future generations. We make a difference in the lives of Albertans through rewarding and diverse career opportunities.

The Ministry of Assisted Living and Social Services leads housing, assisted living and continuing care, seniors, income, employment and homelessness supports, disability services, and other social-based programs. For more information about ALSS, visit our website: https://www.alberta.ca/assisted-living-and-social-services .

The Housing Division and Alberta Social Housing Corporation branch deliver Information Technology and Reporting solutions that help Albertans access affordable housing and housing supports. Through collaboration, innovation, and data-informed decision-making, the division works to strengthen housing outcomes and support sustainable communities throughout Alberta.

Are you passionate about transforming business needs into meaningful reporting solutions? Do you enjoy collaborating with users, working with data, and developing reports that support informed decision-making? If so, we invite you to join our team as a Business Data Analyst.

The Business Data Analyst position exists to support the reporting team and translate business needs into simple reporting solution requirements. The role works directly with program areas to understand reporting needs, supports early requirements definition, and delivers straightforward reports and dashboards, enabling senior technical resources to focus on complex data development, architecture, and strategic initiatives.

Role Responsibilities

Reporting to the Director, Digital and Business Solutions, the Business Data Analyst supports the reporting and analytics function by working closely with program areas to identify reporting needs, define requirements, and develop practical reporting solutions. This role acts as a key liaison between business clients and technical resources, ensuring reporting requests are clearly understood, documented, and translated into effective reports and dashboards. The position provides foundational analytical and operational support that enables senior technical resources to focus on complex data development, architecture, and strategic initiatives.

The Job Responsibilities Include:


Client Engagement and Requirements Definition The Business Data Analyst supports the identification and documentation of business reporting needs to ensure analytical work is aligned with program requirements.


Key Responsibilities Include:


Engaging with program areas to gather, clarify, and document reporting and information needs.
Assisting with the development of business requirements, definitions, assumptions, and reporting specifications.
Translating reporting requests into clear user stories, work items, and development tickets.
Identifying relevant data sources, data gaps, and reporting limitations.
Communicating requirements effectively to technical team members to support report development and implementation.
Supporting intake and prioritization processes to ensure reporting requests are appropriately managed.
Development of Reporting Products The Business Data Analyst develops and maintains straightforward reporting solutions that support operational activities and business decision-making.


Key Responsibilities Include:


Designing and developing standard reports and dashboards using Power BI (Business Intelligence) and related reporting tools.
Applying established reporting standards, templates, and visualization best practices.
Configuring data queries, calculations, and transformations using approved methodologies.
Testing and validating reports to ensure accuracy, reliability, and usability.
Supporting ongoing maintenance and enhancement of reporting products based on business needs and client feedback.
Ensuring reporting outputs meet quality standards and align with documented requirements.
Operational System and Data Support The Business Data Analyst provides operational support for reporting systems and data-related requests.


Key Responsibilities Include:


Responding to service requests and inquiries related to reporting and data.
Documenting issues, enhancement opportunities, and system change requests.
Supporting troubleshooting activities and working with technical resources to resolve reporting issues.
Identifying recurring issues and escalating trends or systemic concerns for further review.
Collaborating with system owners and program areas to identify and address data gaps that impact reporting requirements.
Supporting data quality initiatives through issue identification and resolution tracking.


Role Responsibilities 2


Support to Technical and Analytical Resources The Business Data Analyst provides foundational support to technical and analytical team members to support the timely delivery of reporting solutions.


Key Responsibilities Include:


Preparing, organizing, and validating data for use in reporting and analysis.
Supporting testing activities for reports, dashboards, and data solutions.
Assisting with intake management, workload tracking, and request prioritization.
Maintaining documentation related to business requirements, technical decisions, processes, and reporting standards.
Supporting implementation, deployment, and rollout activities for reporting products.
Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve processes and service delivery.
Communication and User Support The Business Data Analyst supports the successful adoption and use of reporting products through effective communication and client support.


Key Responsibilities Include:


Explaining reports, dashboards, and key information to clients using clear, plain language.
Responding to routine client inquiries and providing end-user support.
Developing user guides, procedures, and training materials.
Gathering client feedback and identifying opportunities to enhance reporting products and services.
Supporting client adoption of standardized reporting tools, practices, and processes.
Building positive working relationships with users and fostering a client-focused service approach.


The Job Description is provided for Further details on this position.

APS Competencies

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.

Systems Thinking


Takes a long-term view towards organization’s objectives and how to achieve them.
Takes holistic long-term view of challenges and opportunities.
Anticipates outcomes and potential impacts, seeks user perspectives.
Works towards actions and plans aligned with APS values.
Works with others to identify areas for collaboration.


Creative Problem Solving


Engages the community and resources at hand to address issues.
Engages perspective to seek root causes.
Find ways to improve complex systems.
Employs resources from other areas to solve problems.
Engages others and encourages debate and idea generation to solve problems while addressing risks.


Develop Networks


Leverages relationships to build input and perspective.
Looks broadly to engage users.
Open to perspectives towards long-term goals.
Actively seeks input into change initiatives.
Maintains user relationships.


Agility


Identifies and manages required change and the associated risks.
Identifies alternative approaches and supports others to do the same.
Proactively explains impact of changes.
Anticipates and mitigates emotions of others.
Anticipates obstacles and stays focused on goals.
Makes decisions and takes action in uncertain situations and creates a backup plan.


Qualifications

Minimum Recruitment Standards

University graduation in a field related to computer science, information systems and business analytics, supplemented by two years related experience.

Equivalency: Directly related education or experience considered on the basis of:

1 year of education for 1 year of experience; or

1 year of experience for 1 year of education

The Following Experience Is Required:


Experience in Power BI (Business Intelligence), Data Analysis and Microsoft Fabrics.
Experience gathering, documenting, and interpreting business requirements to support reporting and operational processes.
Experience developing, maintaining, or supporting reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using reporting or business intelligence tools.
Experience analyzing data and identifying trends, issues, or opportunities to support business decision-making.
Knowledge of data analysis, business analysis, reporting, or related methodologies gained through education, training, or practical experience.
Experience working with multiple data sources and validating information to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and reporting information in clear, plain language.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a client-focused environment.
Experience collaborating with users and supporting service requests, inquiries, or operational business needs.


The Following Experience Is Considered As Assets:


Experience using Power BI (Business Intelligence) to design, develop, and maintain business reports and dashboards.
Experience working with SQL or other data query tools.
Knowledge of data visualization principles and reporting best practices.
Education, certification, or specialized training in Data Analysis, Business Analysis, Business Intelligence, Analytics, Information Management, or a related discipline.
Experience documenting business requirements, user stories, business processes, or technical specifications.

Title: Analyst, Platform & Enablement
Description:
Role Summary

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the Analytics Architecture team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. In this role you will build, validate, and maintain the analytical logic behind McAfee’s most critical consumer business metrics — retention rate, trial conversion, bookings, subscriber counts, and marketing effectiveness. You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.

This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.

Position Details

About The Role


Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives.
Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively.


About You


You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
You have deep expertise in subscription or SaaS business metrics — including retention rate, churn, auto-renewal, trial conversion, LTV, and bookings — ideally in a consumer technology or eCommerce context.
Data and coding fluency — you are a self-starter comfortable using SQL, Python, and generative AI tools to access data and deliver analysis independently.
You have hands-on experience with Databricks (SQL,Python, PySpark, Delta Lake) and can write, review, and troubleshoot complex analytical queries and data pipelines.
You have hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking ecosystems such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools, including familiarity with events, sessions, users, UTM parameters, attribution, funnels, and conversion measurement.
You have experience with BI and reporting platforms — particularly Power BI.
You have experience with data validation and reconciliation — comparing data across source systems, identifying discrepancies, and documenting business rules that govern metric calculations.
You are comfortable performing root cause analysis — diagnosing why a metric moved, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and presenting findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches — scoping the data needed, defining assumptions, and delivering concise answers under time pressure.
You have experience working in agile environments — managing your own backlog across 2-week sprints, balancing recurring reporting with project work, and communicating progress and blockers proactively.


Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.

We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.


Bonus Program
Pension and Retirement Plans
Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
Paid Time Off
Paid Parental Leave
Support for Community Involvement


We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

The anticipated compensation for this position is CAD $122,010.00/Yr. - CAD $165,070.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

This role focuses on data and reporting software (not PI tag/asset configuration).

Sustain mill reporting data layers and dashboards to deliver trusted, timely operational insights.

Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. We’re proud to be one of Canada’s most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

Overview Of Role

As the Analyst, Offer Management & Optimization, you will tackle the complex puzzle of airline pricing by bringing WestJet's Offer Management strategy to life through data-driven execution. This role is focused on actively optimizing fares, designing dynamic bundles, and leveraging large datasets to test and deploy modern offer strategies.

Acting as a critical bridge between Commercial and Technology teams, working alongside Pricing, Revenue Management, Digital, Distribution, and external technology partners, you will ensure WestJet delivers innovative retailing capabilities that directly boost revenue and elevate guest value.

Offer Execution & Optimization


Support the evolution and daily execution of WestJet's Offer Management capabilities across:
Fare price optimization
Ancillary price optimization
Dynamic bundle generation
Offer optimization and decisioning
Commercial experimentation and testing
Offer governance and configuration
Collaborate closely with Pricing and Revenue Management teams to ensure pricing strategies are effectively executed through Offer Management tools.


Cross-Functional Delivery


Manage day-to-day technical workflows with internal teams and external vendors, using tools like Postman to validate API requests, troubleshoot integrations, and ensure seamless offer delivery.
Participate in the business delivery of new capabilities by working with stakeholders across the organization including Pricing, Revenue Management, Distribution, Digital, Commercial Technology, Finance, and the Contact Centre.
Gather and document business requirements, coordinate testing, and assist with change management and release readiness to ensure successful implementations


Performance Management


Monitor product performance, build queries, and identify optimization opportunities by tracking key commercial metrics, including:
Revenue uplift
Conversion rates
Ancillary attachment
Bundle performance
Pricing effectiveness
Customer adoption
Provide regular reporting, dashboards, and actionable recommendations to leadership

Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline

A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

Job Description

The team:

We are a unified, collaborative marketing team focused on creating meaningful client connections that drive business growth. We combine deep insights with strong partnerships to deliver timely, relevant, and impactful experiences for our clients. Our team is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. We align closely with distribution partners to generate demand and unlock new opportunities across the business. Above all, we measure and optimize our efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value, drive engagement, and strengthen loyalty to Invesco.

The role:

The Content Enablement Content Analyst is a key role within Invesco’s Global Content Enablement team, supporting the Americas & EMEA Marketing organization. This position executes the content strategy and roadmap to enhance the quality, accessibility, and usability of content across the EMEA region. The role focuses on building and managing content infrastructure, ensuring accurate categorization, distribution, and access across platforms and audiences. It partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver consistent, well-governed content solutions and ensure requirements are clearly defined and tested. This hands-on role is critical to improving content quality and driving engagement, ultimately enabling a stronger client and investment experience.

Responsibilities of the role:

Provides analytics support primarily for EMEA content domains, with additional support for North America.
Partners closely with EMEA Content Product Owners to deliver analysis across development, deployment, and research initiatives.
Defines and standardizes content quality metrics, building reporting and dashboards to provide visibility into content performance for senior leadership.
Collaborates with EMEA and NA domain experts to develop and maintain global taxonomy, aligning stakeholders to standardized definitions and fields.
Bridges business and technology teams to ensure solutions meet requirements and align with strategic priorities.
Maps business processes, develops expertise in content sources, and provides recommendations to improve content effectiveness.
Translates stakeholder needs into user stories and supports execution of content initiatives, including testing, impact analysis, and cross-team coordination.
Leads governance and documentation efforts, including content quality monitoring, process improvement, issue escalation, and maintaining records in tools such as Jira and Confluence.


Requirements of the role:

Bachelor’s degree, 5+ years in technology platforms, project management, or content development and distribution.
Experience with CMS and/or DAM platforms, content lifecycle management, and content migrations, including API-based integrations.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content analysis and UX or digital marketing concepts.
Strong skills in workflow/process mapping, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
Advanced technical proficiency, including SQL and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables; VBA a plus), along with strong desktop tool capabilities.
Strong analytical and statistical reasoning skills, with ability to organize, analyze, and communicate large data sets with accuracy and attention to detail.
Knowledge of content categorization (campaign, program, asset class, product), with preferred experience in investment or asset management content.
Client-focused, execution-oriented professional with strong communication, organizational, relationship-building, and influencing skills, plus a data-driven approach to measuring content performance and impact.

Title: Decision Support Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 46744

Organization

Vancouver is consistently ranked as one of the world’s most liveable and environmentally sustainable cities. Recognized among BC’s Top Employers and Canada’s Greenest Employers, the City of Vancouver is seeking colleagues who can help advance our core commitments to exceptional public service, sustainability, equity, and an outstanding quality of life for all residents.

With a strong commitment to being a City of Reconciliation, we invite you to join our dedicated team and become part of an innovative, inclusive, and engaging workplace. A career with the City of Vancouver and within the broader public service, offers meaningful work where you play a key role in ensuring equitable access to services, upholding ethical governance, and supporting the needs of citizens with integrity and dedication.

Main Purpose and Function

The Decision Support Analyst is part of the City’s Centre of Expertise for Performance Measurement and Decision Support, within the Strategy and Project Support Office (SPSO). The role supports evidence-informed decision-making across the City by helping leaders understand service performance, assess options, evaluate outcomes, and identify opportunities to improve accountability, transparency and value for money.

The role combines performance measurement, service evaluation, business analysis and business intelligence to help leaders make sound strategic, operational and service-delivery decisions. A core part of the team’s mandate is enabling the delivery of an enterprise-wide corporate planning process and the evaluation of City services, ensuring decisions are grounded in consistent, comparable evidence.

The analysis considers operational, financial, resource and service-delivery implications and supports recommendations to managers and senior leaders.

The Decision Support Analyst partners closely with corporate and departmental teams to build a culture of data-informed decision-making across the City. This includes increasing data literacy, enabling data exploration, supporting adoption of business intelligence tools, and translating complex analysis into clear, decision-ready insight.

Specific Duties/Responsibilities


Performance Measurement and Corporate Planning
Supports performance measurement reporting by linking City services and service plans to performance metrics, departmental work plans and the corporate plan.
Supports the design and delivery of the City’s enterprise-wide corporate planning process, helping connect service plans, performance measures and corporate priorities.
Supports corporate, capital and service-planning processes by connecting service plans and performance information to operating requirements, costs and resource implications.
Develops, monitors and analyzes performance metrics and benchmarks to assess the efficiency, effectiveness and outcomes of City services.
Helps identify short-term and long-term measures that support continuous improvement, service planning and corporate accountability.
Reviews and analyzes how major City decisions may affect service plans, performance measures and service-delivery outcomes.

The tools you need to succeed – including the tools for the job as well as training and development programs
A successful and knowledgeable team to be part of and learn from
Competitive base pay plus the ability to earn more tied to your success – the only limit is your potential

Career paths so you can advance in the company
Awarded Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures with a proudly diverse and inclusive team

Provide value-add analysis to drive performance

Develop process flows and end to end functional designs
Builds effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Identify opportunities to improve processes and systems, support implementation of best practices, and drive continuous improvements
Drive / Support projects and initiatives as assigned

Excellent communication skills – both verbal and written

Our values guide us, and our mission drives us. Come join us and help deliver financial wellness for the whole family, putting the tools of wealth-making into everyone’s hands.

Acorns is seeking a Data Analyst I to serve as a key partner for our Core Experience team, specifically focused on our Investing and Banking product lines. In this role, you will leverage data to optimize the customer journey, working at the intersection of Product, Finance, and Operations to ensure our core features deliver maximum value to our customers. You will play a vital role in shaping the product roadmap by transforming raw data into actionable insights that drive retention and enhance the overall customer experience.

Acorns is a remote-first organization, offering the flexibility to work remotely while providing optional access to office space in Irvine, CA.

What You Will Do At Acorns


Collaborate with the Core Experience team to drive the ideation and rigorous analysis of product experiments.
Partner with Product, Finance, and Operations to build and maintain robust reports and dashboards specifically for our Core Experience product lines.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract data from various sources for deep-dive analysis.
Utilize Databricks and DBT to transform raw data into clean, accessible datasets for the broader team.
Design and manage intuitive Tableau dashboards that track key performance indicators (KPIs) for Investing and Banking features.
Monitor customer behavior and product performance using Amplitude to identify opportunities for friction reduction and growth.
Work with managers and cross-functional teams to establish priorities, including new infrastructure and tool building.


What You Will Bring To Acorns


3+ years of Analytics experience, preferably supporting product development or financial services.
Strong SQL skills for data extraction and experience with data visualization tools like Tableau.
A solid understanding of statistical concepts and hands-on experience of A/B testing methodologies and product experimentation.
Familiarity with modern data stack tools such as Databricks, DBT, and product analytics platforms like Amplitude.
The ability to translate complex numerical findings into clear, persuasive recommendations for non-technical stakeholders in Finance and Operations.
Hunger to deliver game-changing products.
Exceptional drive and precision in delivery.
A belief that your work is tied to your life's mission.
Optimistic about the potential of societal change.


You are not expected to have experience with all listed requirements. If you feel passionate about Acorns' mission, vision, and values, please apply.

What We Offer


Competitive salary and stock options
A comprehensive benefits package for you and your family
Flexible work location, hours, and paid time off
401(k) matching
Monthly Acorns account contribution & GoHenry account for your family
Mindfulness and Financial Wellness resources, Headspace and Addition Wealth
Acorns Career Development Program (Ongoing training sessions, development plans, development check-ins, Cornerstone’s online training platform)
Roots Leadership Program for Emerging Leaders
Community week onsite gatherings and various virtual events
Talented and motivated team members who care deeply about one another, our mission, and our customers.
The rare opportunity to create a new world. We inspire one another every day to do meaningful work that solves big societal challenges.


About Acorns

Acorns is a financial wellness app that helps everyday people and families save and invest money for the long term. Since 2014, Acorns has grown into a global company with multiple life-stage products serving the needs of kids, teens, adults, and parents. Named one of Time’s “World’s Best Brands of 2024,” Acorns has helped over 14 million people save & invest over $25 billion dollars, much of it from spare change and small amounts.

Description:
Location:

Toronto, ON, Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

Language:

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills are required.

Salary:

$70,000 to $82,000 annually




About the Opportunity

Are you passionate about turning data into meaningful business insights? We are seeking a Business Analyst, Parking Development to support the evolution of a large municipal parking network through data-driven analysis, operational reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives. While this role includes elements of business analysis and project support, the primary focus is on interpreting data, measuring performance, and providing actionable recommendations that improve operations and customer experience.

Working alongside cross-functional teams including Operations, Finance, IT, and external partners, you'll help shape strategic initiatives by developing dashboards, monitoring key performance indicators, evaluating trends, and supporting the implementation of innovative parking solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data while collaborating with stakeholders to drive informed business decisions.




What's In It for You

Join an organization that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. You'll gain exposure to strategic initiatives, work with experienced professionals across multiple business areas, and play a meaningful role in enhancing services that impact thousands of residents and visitors every day. This is a workplace that encourages learning, values fresh perspectives, and supports professional growth.




Your Responsibilities

You'll analyze operational, financial, and customer data to identify trends, measure performance, and provide recommendations that support business decisions.
You'll develop and maintain dashboards, reports, KPIs, and performance metrics that provide meaningful insights for leadership and project teams.
You'll support business analysis activities by gathering requirements, documenting business processes, and identifying opportunities for operational improvements.

Description:
We’re in this for the greater good at ParetoHealth. Our mission is collective greatness, nothing less will do. Our team is a single force united in the drive to transform employee health benefits.

The company was founded in 2011 to help small and medium-sized businesses fight the rising cost of employee health benefits. We blazed the trail with financing innovations that reduce the risks in self-insurance and deliver significant savings—and we continue to lead with a growing ecosystem of partners and world-class cost control solutions.

But success is measured by more than dollars alone and we measure ours by the good that comes from knowing that every client and all their employees can count on effective, affordable healthcare for years to come.

Please note that ParetoHealth does not provide employment visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship both now or in the future.

About The Team

At ParetoHealth, the Analytics team sits at the intersection of healthcare data, business strategy, and decision-making. We work with rich medical, pharmacy, stoploss, and business datasets to generate insights that directly influence product strategy, client outcomes, underwriting, and internal operations. The team partners closely with a varied set of stakeholders to move from questions to action, promoting data-driven decision making across the organization. We do this within a team culture of collaboration, shared responsibility, mutual respect, and growth.

Position Summary:

This role is designed for an experienced, analytically sophisticated individual contributor who feels most at home in the space between data science and traditional BI analytics.

As a Data Analyst, you will partner closely with Data Scientists and cross-functional stakeholders to tackle complex, ambiguous analytical problems, focusing on the operationalization and maintenance of solutions. You will contribute to analyses end-to-end, with a focus on long-term sustainability and enterprise-wide utilization of solutions.

This role is not focused on building predictive models or machine learning systems for production, and it does not include people management responsibilities. Success in this role comes from analytic rigor, a deep interest in efficiency and standardization, and the ability to turn complex data into decisions. You will report to the VP of Analytics.

Key Responsibilities:
Support End-to-End Analyses
Partner with Lead Analysts/Data Scientists to understand business priorities and translate them into analytical approaches
Design, test, and refine appropriate methodologies for complex analytical questions with an eye toward long term sustainability
Work directly with large, messy healthcare datasets, including medical and pharmacy claims
Build and maintain robust SQL queries and analytical datasets
Deliver Decision-Ready Insights
Develop and support clear visualizations and summaries that communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Translate complex analyses into actionable recommendations in partnership with Analytics teammates
Document methodologies, assumptions, and limitations to ensure transparency and repeatability
Collaborate Within the Team
Work closely with Data Scientists and Lead Analysts to support exploratory analyses, hypothesis generation, and interpretation of results
Partner with Analytics teammates to align definitions, methodologies, and data quality standards
Contribute through collaboration and shared problem-solving
Drive Business Impact
Support stakeholder-identified opportunities where analytics can improve business outcomes
Support teams across the organization, including underwriting, product, account management, and cost containment
Required Skills & Qualifications:
A problem-solver with a natural sense of curiosity, analytic rigor, and a deep interest in understanding complex healthcare data
A collaborator with proven ability to work cross-functionally across many different stakeholders to create and deliver insights
A strong communicator who effectively shares information at the appropriate level across a wide variety of audiences
A self-starter with a demonstrated track record of owning projects from idea to execution
A critical thinker with demonstrated ability to be creative, strategic, and to apply strong business judgement
A translator who can turn complex analysis into actionable insights and recommendations for the business

Core Qualifications:

3-5+ years’ experience in a healthcare-based analytics role, preferably in the health benefits space/insurance industry, with a solid understanding of the US based health insurance system.
Hands-on experience working with administrative healthcare data (medical and pharmacy claims)
Strong mathematical and statistical foundations, including familiarity with quantitative reasoning, distributions, rates, and variability as applied to real-world healthcare data
Strong SQL skills, including building, optimizing, and validating complex analytical queries
Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau
Experience using Python for analysis and data wrangling
Experience in data cleaning, validation, and exploratory analysis using large, complex datasets
Understanding of analytical methods, including descriptive statistics, cohort analysis, risk assessment, trend analysis, and causal thinking
Strong analytic judgment: knowing which method to use, why, and when
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative/analytic field, Master’s preferred

Bonus Qualifications:

Deep knowledge of Python (advanced modeling not required)
Experience working with data from CRM systems, e.g., Salesforce
Familiarity with underwriting and actuarial risk assessments for healthcare insurance coverage
Familiarity with AWS Serverless Services and data tools, such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Sagemaker and EMR

Perks & Benefits:

Fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits.
Flexible PTO
401k company contribution
Tuition reimbursement
Professional development allowance
Transportation allowance and daily parking reimbursement 
Engaging hybrid work environment

Fire in the belly

The drive to learn, to improve, and to deliver outstanding value every day.

See the field

The ability to see the big picture and prepare to meet tomorrow’s needs.

Get it done right

The passion to produce at higher rates and to the highest standards.

For the greater good

A united community creating better health benefit solutions for all.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description:

Changing the World, One Kibble at a Time

Champion Petfoods is expanding! We are excited to announce we are looking for a Data Analyst to join our rapidly growing company.

Champion Petfoods is an award-winning pet food crafter with a reputation of trust spanning 35+ years. From our humble beginnings, founded in a small town in Alberta, Canada, Champion – with its ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands – is a key player in the global premium pet food industry.

Our purpose, To Earn Pet Lover Trust Every Day so Pets Thrive for a Lifetime, provides the foundation for our highest aspirations as a company. Being a partner to the communities that surround us – and the environment that sustains us – are top priorities.

We would love to hear from you if you are passionate about personal and professional growth and see yourself as a key player contributing to our continued success as an award-winning company.

Here’s The Scoop - Summary

We are looking for a data-driven, detail-oriented Data Analyst, preferably within the pet food or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry.

In this role, you will support end-to-end supply chain operations by providing actionable insights across multiple functions and serve as the centralized resource for supply chain data and KPI governance.

The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, cross-functional environment and is passionate about using data to enhance operational efficiency and support Champion Petfoods’ commitment to delivering high-quality nutrition to pets worldwide.

The Supply Chain Analyst works out of our Corporate office in Edmonton (AB) or Nashville (TN) and works a hybrid schedule with 3 days in-person.

Key Responsibilities:


Analyze data across supply chain to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process improvements
Identify supply chain performance gaps through data analysis, proactively engage with relevant stakeholders to understand root causes, and lead cross-functional efforts to develop and implement innovative solutions.
Develop and maintain real-time dashboards, data objects, and reports that track key supply chain metrics
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align analytics outputs with business needs
Communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders at all levels, enabling data-driven decision-making.
Assist in the deployment and continuous improvement of supply chain analytics tools and technologies


Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
Experience in supply chain analytics or data analysis, preferably within the food or pet food industry.
Proficiency with data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, Python.
Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
Experience with data visualization platforms (preferably Power BI).
Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively across teams.
Experience with advanced analytics techniques such as machine learning or predictive modeling preferred.
Experience in Generative AI development preferred.
Familiarity with Databricks preferred.
Understanding of E2E supply chain processes preferred.


What can you expect from Champion?


Safety: A strong commitment to ensure all people are provided with a safe, healthy and respectful environment.
Earnings: Competitive wages, annual bonus eligibility, 401k/RRSP with company matching.
Industry Competitive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision and employee assistance programs to meet your individual or family needs.
Continuing Education: In house & online learning & development, as well as an education assistance program.
Quality: a dedication to uphold the highest standards of authenticity, nutritional integrity, and food safety, to earn the trust of Pet Lovers everywhere.
Other Perks: Free bag of premium pet food each month.


What are you waiting for? Join the pack!

Come as you are.

We value diversity in all forms and know the power it can bring. Workplace equality allows for creative ideas to bloom, diverse points of views to be heard, and increases overall happiness. That sounds pretty good to us.

Champion is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of your race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, or any other creed, you are wanted here.

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Data at Brex

The Data organization develops insights, models, and data infrastructure for teams across Brex, including Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Operations. Our Data Scientists, Analysts, and Engineers work together to make data—and insights derived from data—a core asset across the company.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Analyst II (DA), you will play a central role in enhancing the operational tracking and reporting capabilities of different business teams across Brex. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and partner teams to drive meaningful insights for the business through visualizations, self-service tools, and ad-hoc analyses. This is a high-impact role in a fast-paced fintech environment where your work will directly influence strategic decisions.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities


Apply data visualization and storytelling skills in creating business intelligence solutions (such as Looker and/or Hex dashboards) that enable actionable insights.
Perform ad-hoc analyses and deep dives to investigate business questions, surface trends, and provide data-driven recommendations.
Develop self-service data tools and processes that empower business stakeholders to independently monitor the performance and health of their respective areas.
Collaborate closely with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to identify data sources, enable data pipelines, and support the development of analytical data models that operationalize reports and dashboards.
Implement and maintain rigorous data quality checks to ensure the integrity and robustness of datasets used across dashboards, reports, and analyses.
Partner with various departments—including Sales, Operations, Product, and Finance—to understand their data needs and deliver tailored analyses and reporting that support strategic planning.
Contribute to the automation of recurring analyses and reporting workflows using Python.


Requirements


3+ years of experience in data analytics or a related role in a professional setting.
2+ years of experience working directly with Sales, Operations, Product, or equivalent business teams.
Fluency in SQL to manipulate data and perform complex analyses (CTEs, window functions, joins across large datasets).
Experience with Python for data analysis, automation, or scripting.
Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools (Looker, Hex, Tableau, or similar).
Strong quantitative and analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to translate data into business insights.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of technical fluency.
Experience with generative AI and LLM-based tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to perform and accelerate analyses, automated reporting, and build self-service data tools.


Bonus points


Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).
Familiarity with dbt for data modeling and transformation.
Exposure to data pipeline orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).
Experience in fintech, financial services, or payments.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities.


Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $93,600 - $117,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data and analytics are at the heart of Lyft's products and decision-making. As a member of the Lyft Urban Solutions team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of bike & scooter share by leveraging data to improve the performance of our bikeshare and scooter markets across America. A successful candidate thrives in a dynamic and collaborative environment, has a natural curiosity, and isn’t afraid to dive deep.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Operations, Hardware, Software, Product and Finance teams to identify opportunities and gaps in performance. You will work in a fast-paced environment where your analytical insights will directly impact strategic decisions around hardware product development, staffing, and product changes, ultimately driving better performance and long-term investments in micromobility infrastructure.

We’re looking for a passionate and driven Data Analyst to tackle some of the most complex and impactful challenges in micromobility. If you’re excited about shaping the future of urban mobility through data, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:


Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science & Analytics, Operations, Finance and other cross-functional stakeholders on initiatives to improve operational performance
Develop frameworks and scalable processes to streamline reporting, drive decision-making and prioritization
Forecast operational requirements needed to maintain high service levels and meet contractual and financial targets
Work with our bike & scooter share markets to deliver ongoing support and deep dive analyses on performance; monitor and diagnose performance and present findings to key stakeholders
Collaborate with cross-functional teammates to tackle complex problems including: asset maintenance, system health and labor forecasting


Experience:


3+ years experience in data analytics in a high-growth environment, preferably a consulting, operations or transportation / logistics space
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent relevant professional experience
Highly skilled in SQL and quantitative analysis. You can deep dive into large amounts of data, draw meaningful insights, dissect business issues and draw actionable conclusions
Ability to develop scalable approaches and produce data visualizations to drive business insights and provide tangible solutions; experience building dashboards for performance analysis is a plus
Extreme comfort working with ambiguity. Ability to translate unclear issues or unstructured problems into clearly defined requirements with minimal oversight
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships, trust and influence with cross-functional partners
Great communication (listening, written, and oral) skills with the ability to present findings & recommendations targeted to the audience in question
Strong attention to detail, structured thinking and experiences developing processes to reduce human error
Adept at contextualizing real world operations into analytical problem solving
Passionate about sustainable mobility and active transportation
A strong sense of product ownership - you’re constantly looking for ways to improve the customer’s experience and aren’t afraid to get your hands dirty to do so
Bonus: Proficiency in Python and associated data science libraries


Benefits:


Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
Subsidized commuter benefits
Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Title: Data Analyst, SMB Self-Serve
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data and analytics are at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to support our Self-Serve segment — the fastest-growing part of Lyft's B2B portfolio, serving small and mid-size businesses across North America. This is a hands-on role for an analyst who is energized by turning product and customer data into insights that shape strategy — and who builds those insights on a foundation others can trust and reuse.

You will be the dedicated analytical partner to the Self-Serve product team, measuring how new features — a redesigned signup experience, onboarding improvements, and lifecycle campaigns — drive customer activation and growth. You'll own the funnel from acquisition through engagement, define the metrics that matter, and deliver the insights that inform where the business invests next. The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a builder's instinct — turning recurring questions into well-defined, reusable datasets instead of one-off answers — and can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:


Produce high-impact analyses on Self-Serve performance that directly inform product and go-to-market strategy
Own the Self-Serve funnel — acquisition, signup, onboarding, and engagement — building the dashboards and datasets that give the team real-time visibility into product health
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to validate instrumentation and surface data gaps before they distort the funnel or new features launch — catching the data quality issues that stay invisible until someone goes looking
Turn recurring reporting into well-defined, reusable datasets, replacing one-off queries with durable foundations others can build on
Identify recurring workflows worth automating, and help build the prompts, context, and guardrails that make AI analytics tooling reliable for the wider team
Conduct deep-dive analyses and design experiments to establish conversion baselines, measure business impact, and uncover the “why” behind performance trends
Partner with Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to inform strategy and drive decisions
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally in a product, growth, or B2B context
Proficiency in SQL — able to write structured and efficient queries on large data sets
Experience with funnel analytics, conversion measurement, and A/B testing (preferred)
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Looker, Mode, or similar
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Familiarity with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, dbt) is a plus
Comfortable using AI coding and analytics tools — LLM assistants, agentic SQL/analysis workflows — to accelerate extraction, exploration, and reporting, while reviewing and validating every query, result, and insight before it reaches stakeholders; you own the correctness of the output, not the tool
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

*This position is not eligible for sponsorship




Data Analyst – Master Data & Enterprise Reporting

Location: La Crosse, WI – Kwik Trip Support Center (Onsite/Hybrid)

Job Type: Full‑time




About the Role

As a Data Analyst on Kwik Trip’s IT Data Services team, you will help ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of the data that powers decision‑making across the company. You will develop and maintain SQL‑based data solutions, support enterprise reporting platforms, and implement master data management (MDM) processes that improve data quality and integrity. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex data challenges and collaborating across business units.




What You’ll Do

Support and manage Kwik Trip’s MDM tools (Informatica, SAS, and future platforms).
Build MDM jobs and pipelines that ingest, match, merge, and distribute data to downstream systems.
Develop and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and ETL processes.
Create and maintain ETL jobs using tools such as Microsoft SSIS, Informatica ETL, and SAS DataFlux.
Support enterprise reporting platforms including Power BI, SSRS, and Sigma.
Build dashboards and reports that provide clear, actionable insights to business partners.
Implement and manage MDM best‑record and matching processes to improve data quality.
Assist in creating and maintaining data dictionaries, data flow diagrams, and integration documentation.
Partner with software vendors to resolve issues, manage upgrades, and stay informed on future enhancements.
Serve as a subject matter expert for enterprise data and support business units with data‑related needs.




What We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
At least two years of related professional experience.
Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases and enterprise software.
Ability to write complex queries and work with advanced database tools.
Experience troubleshooting ETL jobs, SQL procedures, and data integration issues.
Understanding of Master Data and Data Quality concepts.
Ability to develop data requirements and specifications.

Strong problem‑solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Data at Brex

The Data organization develops insights, models, and data infrastructure for teams across Brex, including Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Operations. Our Data Scientists, Analysts, and Engineers work together to make data—and insights derived from data—a core asset across the company.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Analyst II (DA), you will play a central role in enhancing the operational tracking and reporting capabilities of different business teams across Brex. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and partner teams to drive meaningful insights for the business through visualizations, self-service tools, and ad-hoc analyses. This is a high-impact role in a fast-paced fintech environment where your work will directly influence strategic decisions.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities


Apply data visualization and storytelling skills in creating business intelligence solutions (such as Looker and/or Hex dashboards) that enable actionable insights.
Perform ad-hoc analyses and deep dives to investigate business questions, surface trends, and provide data-driven recommendations.
Develop self-service data tools and processes that empower business stakeholders to independently monitor the performance and health of their respective areas.
Collaborate closely with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to identify data sources, enable data pipelines, and support the development of analytical data models that operationalize reports and dashboards.
Implement and maintain rigorous data quality checks to ensure the integrity and robustness of datasets used across dashboards, reports, and analyses.
Partner with various departments—including Sales, Operations, Product, and Finance—to understand their data needs and deliver tailored analyses and reporting that support strategic planning.
Contribute to the automation of recurring analyses and reporting workflows using Python.


Requirements


3+ years of experience in data analytics or a related role in a professional setting.
2+ years of experience working directly with Sales, Operations, Product, or equivalent business teams.
Fluency in SQL to manipulate data and perform complex analyses (CTEs, window functions, joins across large datasets).
Experience with Python for data analysis, automation, or scripting.
Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools (Looker, Hex, Tableau, or similar).
Strong quantitative and analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to translate data into business insights.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of technical fluency.
Experience with generative AI and LLM-based tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to perform and accelerate analyses, automated reporting, and build self-service data tools.


Bonus points


Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).
Familiarity with dbt for data modeling and transformation.
Exposure to data pipeline orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).
Experience in fintech, financial services, or payments.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities.


Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $93,600 - $117,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Position Title : Business Data Analyst

Location : Jersey City, NJ (Onsite/Hybrid from Day 1)

Experience : 8+ Years

Employee Type : Full Time with Benefits




Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with a strong background in Data Engineering and Data Warehousing projects. The ideal candidate will serve as a critical liaison between business stakeholders, data engineering teams, and IT organizations to ensure that data-driven solutions are aligned with business objectives and delivered effectively.

This role requires a blend of business analysis expertise, data domain knowledge, stakeholder management, and technical understanding of modern data platforms, ETL/ELT processes, and reporting solutions.




Key Responsibilities:

Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business and data requirements.
Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for data engineering teams.
Define business rules, data use cases, KPIs, and success criteria.
Work closely with Data Engineers, Architects, and Developers on data integration, ETL/ELT, data pipeline, and data warehousing initiatives.
Analyze and document data flows, source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, and data lineage.
Facilitate requirements workshops, stakeholder meetings, and solution review sessions.
Act as the primary liaison between business users, data teams, and IT stakeholders.
Create and maintain Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, data dictionaries, and related documentation.
Ensure alignment between business expectations and delivered solutions.
Support data governance, data quality, security, and compliance initiatives.
Define test scenarios, test cases, and acceptance criteria.
Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), data validation, and defect resolution activities.
Collaborate with BI and Analytics teams to support dashboards, reporting, and data visualization requirements.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and usability across reporting and analytical platforms.
Support Agile project delivery and participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and requirement refinement sessions.




Required Skills & Experience:

8+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst or Business Analyst, with significant experience supporting Data Engineering or Data Warehousing projects.
Strong understanding of Business Analysis methodologies, requirements management, and stakeholder engagement.
Hands-on experience with data integration, ETL/ELT processes, and enterprise data platforms.
Advanced SQL skills for data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting.
Solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including Star Schema and Snowflake Schema.
Experience with data mapping, data lineage, metadata management, and transformation logic.
Knowledge of data quality frameworks and data validation techniques.
Experience working with data warehouses and data lake technologies such as Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, BigQuery, or similar platforms.
Exposure to cloud platforms including Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Experience with ETL/ELT tools such as Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, or similar technologies.
Familiarity with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Excel.
Experience using JIRA, Azure DevOps, Visio, Lucidchart, or similar tools.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across cross-functional teams.




Preferred Qualifications:

Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Understanding of API integrations, web services, and data exchange mechanisms.
Exposure to Big Data technologies such as Spark and Hadoop.
Knowledge of data governance, data privacy, and regulatory compliance frameworks.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field.
Relevant certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Cloud, or Data Management are a plus.
