Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
1stDibs is a one-of-a-kind online marketplace that connects design lovers to more than one million extraordinary pieces, from furniture and fine art to jewelry and fashion. As a leading global marketplace for design lovers, we enable shoppers to discover beautiful things and engage with top sellers from around the world. We encourage our shoppers to interact with sellers throughout all stages of the transaction, including item inquiries, price negotiations and customization requests.

As a Data Analyst, you will be a foundational architect of our data-driven future. You won't just pull numbers; you will deliver results by uncovering the "why" behind buyer and seller behavior.

What You Will Do


Analyze: Partner cross-functionally to identify trends that guide our global business strategy.
Empower: Design scalable, self-serve dashboards (Looker/Tableau) that help your teammates make faster, smarter decisions.
Optimize: Lead efforts to streamline data collection and translate complex business needs into clear data products.
Experiment: Collaborate with Product and Marketing to run A/B tests that directly influence our user experience.


What You’ll Bring


Experience: 2+ years in data or product analytics.
Technical Toolkit: Proficiency in SQL is required.
Strategic Mindset: An ability to see both the granular details and the "big picture" of a luxury marketplace.
Collaborative Spirit: You thrive when succeeding together and can succinctly exchange ideas with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Education: A degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Math, Econ, Business) or equivalent practical experience

Title: Operations Data Analyst
Description:
About Lantern

Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com.

About You:


You use LOGIC in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. You focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small & big wins.
INCLUSION is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. A diverse and inclusive environment is incredibly important to you. You understand and desire to be a part of a diverse team with different experiences and perspectives & you cherish the differences in each individual that you interact with.
You have the GRIT, drive and ambition to tackle big problems. Big problems require big ideas and a team that supports new ideas.
You care deeply for your customers are driven to keep HUMANITY in all decisions. Your customers aren’t just the individuals using your product. They are the driving factor in your motivation to make a change.
Integrity guides you in life. Focusing on the TRUTH vs. giving people the answers they want to hear.
You thrive in a Team Environment. Collaboration is key in innovation and creating change.


These pillars of LIGHT are a reminder to our team that we are making a difference by providing guidance and support in navigating the often complex and confusing landscape of healthcare. We hope that through this LIGHT, individuals can find their way to the best care, resources, and support they need to get back to life.

If this sounds like you, we would love to connect to speak further about career opportunities at Lantern.

Please apply to our role & someone from our Talent Acquisition Team will reach out to help you navigate our interview process.

Operations Data Analyst

As the Operations Data Analyst for the Outbound Program, you will support the day-to-day data and reporting needs of the outbound Care Advocate team. You will compile, organize, and analyze operational data to help leadership and the team understand performance, identify trends, and make informed decisions. Working closely with the leadership team, you will support the reporting infrastructure and provide ongoing data support as the program grows. This role is a great fit for someone who is detail-oriented, eager to learn, and excited to contribute to a fast paced, growing operation.

Location: Hybrid | USA | Full-time | Preference for Dallas, TX, New York, NY and Washington, DC

Responsibilities:

Data Collection & Reporting


Pull, compile, and organize operational data from CRM systems, dialer platforms, and other contact center tools on a regular cadence
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key outbound program metrics including contact rates, conversion, call volume, and advocate productivity
Deliver daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports to the leadership team
Ensure data accuracy and consistency across all reports and tracking tools


Performance Analysis & Insights


Analyze team and individual advocate performance data to identify trends, patterns, and areas of opportunity
Support the leadership team with data requests, ad hoc analyses, and performance deep dives
Help translate data findings into clear, easy-to-understand summaries for leadership and non-technical stakeholders
Flag data anomalies or performance concerns to leadership in a timely manner


Reporting Infrastructure & Process Support


Assist in building and maintaining the reporting infrastructure and data tracking processes for the outbound program
Develop and maintain tracking tools, spreadsheets, and reporting templates that support program operations
Identify opportunities to streamline data collection and reporting processes and recommend improvements
Document data definitions, reporting processes, and data sources to ensure consistency and continuity


Collaboration & Program Support


Work closely with the leadership team to align reporting with program goals and performance standards
Respond to data requests from cross-functional partners in a timely and accurate manner
Support special projects and initiatives requiring data analysis or reporting as assigned
Other duties and responsibilities as assigned


Requirements:


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Statistics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered
2–3 years of experience in a data, reporting, or operations support role required; contact center or healthcare experience a plus
Exposure to or experience working with AI tools, automation platforms, or emerging analytics technologies a plus
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, formulas, and data visualization
Experience with or exposure to CRM systems, reporting dashboards, or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) preferred
Strong attention to detail with a commitment to data accuracy and consistency
Ability to manage multiple reporting tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present data findings to non-technical audiences
Eagerness to learn, grow, and take on increasing responsibility over time
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a small, cross functional team
Knowledge of healthcare, insurance, or contact center operations a plus


Strong Candidates will:


Be naturally detail-oriented and take pride in accurate, clean, well-organized data
Be comfortable working with large data sets and eager to develop their analytical skills in a real-world environment
Communicate findings clearly – able to turn numbers into a story that non technical teammates can act on
Be proactive and self-directed, taking ownership of recurring reports and flagging issues without being asked
Be excited to help establish and continuously improve reporting processes
Bring curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset to every dataset they touch


Benefits


Medical Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Short & Long Term Disability
Life Insurance
401k with company match
Paid Time Off
Paid Parental Leave




Lantern does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Brightspeed, we are reimagining how people live, work, play and connect by providing fast, reliable internet connections and an awesome customer experience in twenty states throughout the Midwest and South.

Backed by funds managed by Apollo Global Management, our vision is to accelerate the upgrade of copper to fiber optic technologies, bringing faster and more reliable internet service to many rural markets traditionally underserved by broadband providers, while delivering best-in-class customer experience.

Be a part of the team that will make this vision a reality….designing and building a world class fiber network and creating a customer experience second to none.

Check us out on the web!

Job Description

The Data Analyst is responsible for building and delivering scalable datasets, reports, and analytical solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across Brightspeed. This role partners closely with business stakeholders to understand business needs, translate them into actionable analytics, and deliver accurate, high-quality insights that support strategic and operational objectives.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, define data requirements, and translate business questions into scalable analytical solutions.
Extract, integrate, validate, and analyze data from multiple internal and external sources to create trusted datasets for reporting and decision-making.
Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL queries, data pipelines, and analytical models using BigQuery, Python, and other data technologies.
Design, build, and maintain recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and analytical outputs that provide meaningful business insights.
Validate data accuracy and integrity by reconciling results across systems, identifying discrepancies, and partnering with stakeholders to resolve data quality issues.
Analyze trends, patterns, and anomalies, presenting findings through clear visualizations and executive-ready insights that support informed decision-making.
Support cross-functional initiatives involving data engineering, analytics, reporting, and data warehouse or data mart migrations.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of scalable datasets, feature stores, and reusable analytical assets that improve reporting efficiency.
Collaborate effectively across IT, Data, Finance, and business teams to deliver high-quality analytical solutions aligned with organizational priorities.
Stay current with evolving data technologies and continuously identify opportunities to improve data processes, reporting capabilities, and analytical solutions.
May perform other duties as assigned.


The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required.

Qualifications

Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience developing scalable datasets, reporting solutions, and analytical insights in a business environment.
Minimum of 3 years of experience working with cloud-based data platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience working with large-scale data warehouses, data lakes, or lakehouse environments.
Professional certifications in Data Analytics, Cloud Technologies, or related disciplines are preferred.


Skills & Competencies / Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience using additional scripting or query languages as needed.
Advanced experience working with Google BigQuery or comparable cloud-based analytical databases.
Strong understanding of relational database design, data modeling, query optimization, and ETL/ELT concepts.
Experience integrating data from multiple source systems into consolidated analytical datasets.
Experience developing reports and dashboards using business intelligence tools.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and modern analytics architectures.


Business & Analytical Skills


Strong analytical thinking with exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.
Intellectual curiosity to understand business problems and identify meaningful analytical solutions.
Ability to navigate ambiguity and solve complex business problems using logical, data-driven approaches.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical findings into business-friendly insights for executive audiences.
Excellent collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple projects and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.


Preferred Qualifications


Telecommunications industry experience.
Experience with data governance, data quality, and metadata management frameworks.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
Experience supporting enterprise reporting, financial analytics, or executive dashboards.
Professional certifications in Google Cloud Platform, Data Analytics, or related technologies.


Physical Demands & Work Conditions


Primarily office-based or remote office environment with regular use of a computer and standard office equipment.
Ability to participate in virtual and in-person meetings and collaborate with geographically dispersed teams.


Additional Information

WHY JOIN US?

We aspire to contemporary ways of working.

Recognized as a Top Workplace by the Charlotte Observer, Brightspeed HQ is located on the 7th floor of the new Vantage South End - East Tower in Charlotte, NC. We prioritize hiring talent in the Charlotte area, whenever possible, to make it a truly vibrant destination for our hybrid workforce. At Brightspeed, we have roles that are designated as remote, hybrid, office or field-based, depending on the position, business needs and individual circumstances. We also invest in technology that enables our entire team to stay connected. Why? Because Brightspeed recognizes the value of finding the best talent for the job, wherever they may be.

We Offer Competitive Compensation And Comprehensive Benefits.

Our benefits and paid time off programs reflect our underlying belief in promoting overall wellness through physical, emotional and financial health. Brightspeed offers a comprehensive benefit program, including competitive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; an employee assistance program; a 401K plan with company match and a host of voluntary benefits.

Inclusion and belonging are at the center of our grounding belief in Being Real.

When we bring our authentic selves to work, everyone is better as a result. A diverse team helps us be fierce advocates for more accessible, inclusive and high-quality internet, because we believe doing so promotes equity in the communities we serve.

Brightspeed is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to inclusion of all qualified individuals, including individuals with a disability/veterans. Finding the right match for this role is a critical aspect of continuing that success. 




Overview 

We are seeking a senior level Data Analyst to join our client's data team. This role is responsible for using advanced analytic techniques and data visualizations and analysis to investigate business questions, synthesize, and communicate findings, and deliver actionable insights. This role is responsible for using SQL queries and advanced Excel, among other tools, to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. Requirements

Partner with the management team to ensure business questions are clearly defined, scoped, and actionable.
Use SQL and Excel to pull and analyze datasets and turn into actionable insights.
Leverage industry or domain knowledge of the broadband industry to quickly understand data context.
Translate analytic findings into a clear, compelling narrative supported by charts, figures, and tables. 
Self-starter that can take ownership of critical projects from conception to actionable recommendations, directly impacting company strategy and driving measurable performance outcomes. 
Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports that track core KPIs and business performance for executive stakeholders.
Develop professional, polished presentations in PowerPoint, emphasizing readability and clarity.  Deliver insights and recommendations to senior level technical and non-technical audiences, with sensitivity to organizational dynamics.


Qualifications

Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in data analysis, data visualization and data insights is required.
Demonstrated proficiency with SQL queries and advanced Excel feature and functionality is required.
Data visualization experience is necessary.
Must have experience in the broadband industry and understand data in this context/domain.
Excellent communication skills with proven ability to work cross-functionally and present to senior leaders.
Detail-oriented and data savvy, with strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities. Proven ability to distill complex analyses into clear, actionable insights.
Strong foundation in statistics, with ability to apply appropriate analytic techniques.
Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Master's is helpful.

Sand Cherry Associates is required by Colorado law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range considers a wide range of factors considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and delivery model. Years of experience, level of education, geographic location, unique skills/qualifications for the specific role and potential certifications can be key factors in the final compensation for this role.


Benefits


Our team is unique — we are passionate about what we do. At Sand Cherry, our Consultants know they are impacting and shaping our clients' industries. We recognize our employees for their contributions. Our culture is one of the most friendly and communicative in the consulting industry. Sand Cherry is not a top-heavy organization. We offer the opportunity to be part of a digital workforce. Discover the experience that only comes with self-responsibility in the workplace. Our team members manage their own workloads and are expected to deliver exceptional work for our clients. Professional career growth is one of our main priorities, as we affirm that investing in our Consultants and empowering our people will also deliver the best results and value for our clients.

Proven experience as a Chief Data Officer, VP of Data, VP of Analytics, or similar senior data leadership role.

Strong hands-on expertise in machine learning and AI, including experience designing, training, evaluating, and improving models.
Demonstrated experience creating and managing A/B testing or experimentation frameworks to support data-driven decisions.
Proven ability to translate data strategies into measurable business outcomes, ideally connected to revenue growth, customer value, or monetization improvements.
Deep understanding of modern data architecture, cloud data platforms, pipelines, MLOps, and enterprise data infrastructure.
Experience establishing data governance, security, privacy, and compliance frameworks.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, leadership teams, and cross-functional partners.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At ING we are looking for a Data Analyst




Your role and work environment:




We are looking for a passionate, high-energy Data Analyst to join our Data Consumption and Culture Team of Data & AI Tribe




Our mission is to unlock business value from data by driving adoption, understanding, governance, and effective consumption of trusted data products. We work side by side with business stakeholders, data product teams, and technology teams to ensure that analytics and reporting are:




- Trusted and governed

- Easy to understand and use

- Focused on real impact and decision-making




We operate in a collaborative, business-oriented and data-driven environment, where curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement are part of our DNA.




We are building a team of data partners who help the business make better decisions.

Your key responsibilities:

As a Data Analyst you will:




- Design, build and evolve impactful dashboards and reporting solutions using tools like Power BI and MicroStrategy

- Go beyond reporting: analyze data to generate insights that influence business decisions

- Ensure high standards of data quality, consistency and governance across reporting assets

- Partner with stakeholders to define, challenge and refine KPIs and metrics Translate business needs into clear, scalable and reusable reporting solutions

- Create and maintain functional and technical documentation

- Actively contribute to data adoption and data literacy initiatives across the organization

What are we looking for?




We are looking for someone with drive, curiosity and a strong sense of ownership. If you enjoy working close to the business and turning data into real impact, this role is for you.




Key skills and experience:

- Hands-on experience with BI tools (Power BI, MicroStrategy or similar)

- Strong SQL and data analysis skills

- Ability to communicate complex ideas in a simple way, to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

- Passion for continuous improvement and learning




What do we offer?

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.




Check out what is waiting for you!




Balance That Works.

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.

Restaurant card.

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.




Our house will be your home.

In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!




Health insurance.

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).




Life insurance.

We help you protect what matters most to you.




Flexible remuneration.

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…




Free company shuttle.

It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.




Banking benefits.

Special loans with more beneficial conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!




More vitality and more belonging

360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).

Physiotherapy service on site.

Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.

Gympass service.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.

Get to know Us




We are a team of more than 1800 people sharing one idea: doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.




A fully online bank where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with agile methodologies.




And although we are based in Spain, we are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries.




We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging to foster a culture of collaboration and innovation that represents all collectives in the society.




And even though we look orange on the outside, we are green on the inside. Our ambition in Sustainability is Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.




Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA. If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!




At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.




Job Application Safety Reminder




We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

•Apply only via official ING platforms: ING uses Workday and LinkedIn as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn.

•Check the sender’s email carefully: Legitimate communication will always come from @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com.

•No payments or banking details will ever be requested: If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

Title: Data-analist
Description:
Data Analyst




#DataAnalyst #PowerBI #MSFabric #DataDriven #Bouwsector #Analytics #RenotecJobs #WeAreRenotec




Jouw impact als Data Analyst

Bij Renotec maken we elke dag keuzes die impact hebben op onze organisatie. Als Data Analyst zorg jij dat die beslissingen niet op buikgevoel gebeuren, maar op basis van heldere inzichten.

Jij brengt structuur in data over de hele business: van werven en projecten tot ondersteunende diensten. Je maakt verbanden zichtbaar en geeft teams houvast om betere beslissingen te nemen.

Je bouwt geen rapporten om het rapporteren. Je zorgt ervoor dat cijfers richting geven: van budgetopvolging en rendementen tot strategische keuzes.




Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt?

Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar data nog volop in ontwikkeling is. Geen vastgeroeste structuren maar ruimte om zelf te bepalen wat relevant is, hoe je het aanpakt en waar je écht het verschil maakt.




Wie zijn wij?

“Bij Renotec combineren we vakmanschap met innovatie om historisch waardevolle gebouwen, kunstwerken, ondergrondse leidingen en monumenten te restaureren en een nieuwe bestemming te geven. We zijn een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf met een duidelijke missie: medewerkers laten groeien en een duurzame toekomst opbouwen. De werksfeer? Energiek, ondersteunend en collegiaal. Je krijgt de vrijheid om je eigen stempel te drukken en echt impact te maken.”




Wat ga je doen?

Je bouwt en beheert een sterk datafundament: van databronnen tot semantische modellen
Je vertaalt businessvragen naar heldere dashboards en bruikbare inzichten (Power BI)

Title: Data Analyst (Fixed Term Employment)
Description:
Job Description



WHAT YOU’LL DO​

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team for a fixed-term duration of 14 months, covering a parental leave. You’ll bring a solid technical foundation, problem-solving aptitude, and a passion for contributing to a collaborative team environment within sustainability topics. The primary focus is developing high-quality analyses that meet our Resource Use and Circularity sustainability needs and technological standards.



You will be contributing to the short- and long-term priorities aligned with the PI roadmap. Some of your responsibilities will include



Understanding the added value of product / team’s work. Following up OKRs through setting and following up KPIs.
Data discovery, building data products, testing and evaluating model outputs, in collaboration closely with other roles in the product / team, i.e. DE, Business Expert, etc.
Solving complex problems by turning vast amounts of data into business insights through advanced analytics and effectively communicating findings to a variety of stakeholders.
Framing the problem together with stakeholders, exploring large data sets, preparing data for own analysis.
Creating and maintaining documentation related to your work to ensure that stakeholders have the necessary information to understand the data & analysis of input/outputs.
Sharing knowledge in Communities of Practice, thereby enriching collective understanding and fostering a culture of continuous learning.



WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​



You will be part of Tech Sustainability team in Corporate Tech Domain. You will work closely with the data analysts from all sustainability areas and the program manager and data engineer from your scope.







WHO YOU ARE​



We are looking for people with…​



Academic degree in Statistics, Engineering or related field.
Proficiency in Power BI as data visualization and reporting tool.
High proficiency in SQL.
Proven ability to independently lead data projects, maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders, and design technical solutions that address complex business requirements.
Strong experience with data modelling, and different connectors for data solutions (Big Query, SharePoint).
Experience with Google Cloud environment, data quality and testing.

It is also preferred to have...



Working knowledge of Python and/or R for data analysis, automation, and statistical modelling.
Experience working with sustainability data or CSRD legal reporting.
Experience with BigQuery, Dataform, dbt, or similar cloud-based data transformation frameworks.
Knowledge of data governance, data lineage, metadata management, and master data management practices.
Understanding of sustainability reporting standards and regulations (e.g., CSRD, ESRS).

And people who have…​



Experience working in agile, iterative product development environments.
A Proactive, ownership-driven attitude with the ability to manage ambiguity and adapt quickly to change.
Curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset.
A collaborative approach, always looking for ways to enhance the product and the team’s ways of working.





WHO WE ARE​



H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​



We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​



​All our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP)
All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound.
A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where your insights directly influence strategic decisions.
A collaborative culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.





JOIN US​



Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​



Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

Title: Data-analist
Description:
De Organisatie




Qcompany is een kleine, persoonlijke boutique firm in data. Een hecht team van jonge, nieuwsgierige mensen die plezier hebben in hun werk en in elkaar. Wij geloven dat data niet draait om tools, maar om denken, begrijpen en vertalen. Daarom leiden we mensen op, begeleiden we ze intensief en helpen we hen groeien in een vakgebied dat steeds belangrijker wordt. Zie ons als de engineers van jouw carrière: wij helpen je bouwen, bijstellen en versnellen — met aandacht voor inhoud, werk-privébalans en duurzame groei.

De Opportunity




Werk je nu in een officefunctie? Werk je met Excel, rapportages, controles of analyses, maar merk je dat je méér wilt dan alleen uitvoeren? Dan is dit je kans om de stap naar data te maken — zonder dat je al een data-expert hoeft te zijn. Bij Qcompany word je opgeleid tot data-analist. Je leert hoe je data gebruikt om vragen te beantwoorden, patronen te herkennen en organisaties verder te helpen. Na een intensief opleidingstraject ga je aan de slag bij opdrachtgevers, met name binnen de overheid, semi-overheid en grotere organisaties in Nederland. Daar werk je op het snijvlak van business en IT: je vertaalt vragen naar inzichten die ertoe doen.

Verantwoordelijkheden




Als data-analist houd je je bezig met het begrijpen en structureren van informatie. Je werkt met data uit verschillende bronnen en helpt opdrachtgevers grip te krijgen op hun cijfers, processen en prestaties. Je leert vragen te stellen achter de vraag, inzichten te vertalen naar heldere analyses en deze begrijpelijk te presenteren aan collega’s en stakeholders.

Je werkt nooit alleen: je maakt onderdeel uit van het Qcompany-team en krijgt begeleiding, feedback en ruimte om te leren — zowel inhoudelijk als persoonlijk.

Kwalificaties




Je hebt minimaal hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en al enkele jaren ervaring in een officeomgeving, bijvoorbeeld binnen finance, banking, beleid, administratie of een ondersteunende IT-rol. Je werkt graag met cijfers, overzichten en informatie en bent niet bang voor Excel of vergelijkbare tools.

Belangrijker dan je technische kennis is je nieuwsgierigheid: je wilt begrijpen hoe dingen werken en hoe data kan helpen om betere beslissingen te nemen.

Competenties




Je denkt analytisch en gestructureerd, maar kunt ook uitleggen wat je doet. Je durft vragen te stellen, ook als iets nog niet duidelijk is. Je vindt het leuk om te leren, feedback te krijgen en steeds zelfstandiger te worden. Daarnaast pas je goed in een open, informele omgeving waar eerlijkheid, plezier en samenwerking centraal staan.

Entre sus funciones principales se encuentran:




-Tener una visión clara de negocio con el fin de ayudar a las unidades de negocio a mejorar su toma de decisiones con respecto al cliente.

-Titulación de Ingeniero Superior, Matemático o Estadístico.

-Bases Datos SQL y Data Mining.

Title: Data Analyst (Finance)
Description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Analysts and Scientists work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering smart, scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who can dig into our complex databases, look for the root cause of a problem, and design their own solutions by writing code to implement them.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You’ll Be Doing


Working on ETL processes
Creating and maintaining new aggregated views and tables to simplify data querying
Automating analytics, including P&L attribution, daily risk reporting, and short-term investments performance
Performing behavioural liquidity and cash flow analysis
Analysing ad-hoc performance enhancements
Undertaking model-based performance optimisation


What You'll Need


Experience in an analytical role supporting a markets-based business, or at a major financial institution, asset manager, or liquidity provider within a treasury or risk role (FTP, ALM, IRRB, etc.)
A bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline
Impeccable data manipulation and analysis skills with Python and SQL
Evidence of solid mathematical and statistics knowledge
Fluency in English


Nice to have


An advanced degree in a STEM subject
To have participated in university Olympic medal competitions in physics, maths, economics, or programming


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.


Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Title: Data Analyst BI / Power BI – Supply Chain (H/F)
Description:
Consultant Power BI Senior – Supply Chain & Business Intelligence (H/F)




KP-DP – Toulouse

Contexte

Dans le cadre du renforcement de nos équipes, nous recherchons un Consultant Power BI Senior pour intervenir auprès d'un acteur majeur de l'industrie, dans un environnement international à forts enjeux Supply Chain.




Le poste s'inscrit dans une démarche de transformation de la donnée au service de la performance opérationnelle. L'objectif n'est pas uniquement de produire des tableaux de bord, mais de concevoir des solutions décisionnelles robustes permettant aux équipes Achats et Supply Chain de piloter leur activité à partir d'indicateurs fiables, automatisés et pérennes.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement technique exigeant, en interface avec les équipes métiers, les équipes SAP, les équipes IT et les responsables Supply Chain.




Missions

Conception des solutions décisionnelles

Analyser les besoins métiers et traduire les attentes opérationnelles en solutions Business Intelligence.
Concevoir les modèles de données adaptés aux indicateurs de performance Supply Chain.
Structurer les flux d'alimentation et de transformation des données (ETL).
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données utilisées.

Développement Power BI

Développer des tableaux de bord Power BI interactifs et orientés décision.
Concevoir des modèles de données performants et évolutifs.
Développer des mesures avancées en DAX.
Optimiser les performances des datasets, des requêtes et des temps de rafraîchissement.
Mettre en œuvre les règles de sécurité et de gestion des accès aux rapports.
Publier et maintenir les rapports dans l'environnement de diffusion.

Support métier et amélioration continue

Accompagner les équipes métiers dans l'utilisation des tableaux de bord.
Expliquer les indicateurs et les modèles de calcul à des interlocuteurs non techniques.
Participer aux revues d'avancement et au suivi des livrables.
Produire la documentation technique garantissant la maintenabilité des développements.
Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des solutions BI.




Profil recherché

Formation Bac+5 (École d'ingénieur, MIAGE, Informatique décisionnelle, Data Analytics ou équivalent).
5 à 10 ans d'expérience en Business Intelligence, avec une expertise reconnue sur Power BI.
Expérience acquise dans un environnement industriel ; une connaissance des secteurs aéronautique, spatial ou défense est fortement appréciée.
Maîtrise avancée de Power BI, DAX, Power Query et de la modélisation de données.
Bonne connaissance de SQL et des processus ETL.
Expérience des environnements SAP et compréhension des processus Supply Chain.
Capacité à intervenir en autonomie sur l'ensemble du cycle de développement d'une solution décisionnelle.




Compétences clés

Power BI Expert
DAX
Power Query (M)
SQL
ETL
Data Modeling
Data Visualization
SAP
Business Intelligence
Supply Chain Analytics
KPI Management
Optimisation des performances Power BI




Ce qui fera la différence

Une expertise reconnue dans le développement de solutions Power BI à forte volumétrie.
Une bonne compréhension des processus Achats et Supply Chain.
Une capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques.
Une approche structurée, orientée qualité des données et performance des solutions.
Une expérience dans un environnement industriel international.




Pourquoi nous rejoindre

Vous interviendrez sur une mission à forte valeur ajoutée, au cœur des enjeux de pilotage de la Supply Chain d'un grand groupe industriel.

Vous participerez à la conception d'outils décisionnels utilisés quotidiennement par les équipes opérationnelles et contribuerez directement à l'amélioration de la performance à travers la donnée.




Localisation

Toulouse
demarrage : septembre.
Mission principalement sur site,




Prérequis

Anglais professionnel indispensable : l'ensemble des échanges, de la documentation technique et des livrables est réalisé en anglais.
Être éligible aux habilitations et autorisations d'accès requises pour intervenir dans un environnement relevant des secteurs aéronautique, spatial et défense, incluant si nécessaire les habilitations de sécurité et les autorisations d'accès aux zones réglementées.

L'objectif n'est pas uniquement de produire des tableaux de bord, mais de concevoir des solutions décisionnelles robustes permettant aux équipes Achats et Supply Chain de piloter leur activité à partir d'indicateurs fiables, automatisés et pérennes.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement technique exigeant, en interface avec les équipes métiers, les équipes SAP, les équipes IT et les responsables Supply Chain.


Missions

Conception des solutions décisionnelles

  • Analyser les besoins métiers et traduire les attentes opérationnelles en solutions Business Intelligence.
  • Concevoir les modèles de données adaptés aux indicateurs de performance Supply Chain.
  • Structurer les flux d'alimentation et de transformation des données (ETL).
  • Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données utilisées.

Développement Power BI

  • Développer des tableaux de bord Power BI interactifs et orientés décision.
  • Concevoir des modèles de données performants et évolutifs.
  • Développer des mesures avancées en DAX.
  • Optimiser les performances des datasets, des requêtes et des temps de rafraîchissement.
  • Mettre en œuvre les règles de sécurité et de gestion des accès aux rapports.
  • Publier et maintenir les rapports dans l'environnement de diffusion.

Support métier et amélioration continue

  • Accompagner les équipes métiers dans l'utilisation des tableaux de bord.
  • Expliquer les indicateurs et les modèles de calcul à des interlocuteurs non techniques.
  • Participer aux revues d'avancement et au suivi des livrables.
  • Produire la documentation technique garantissant la maintenabilité des développements.
  • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des solutions BI.


Profil recherché

  • Formation Bac+5 (École d'ingénieur, MIAGE, Informatique décisionnelle, Data Analytics ou équivalent).
  • 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en Business Intelligence, avec une expertise reconnue sur Power BI.
  • Expérience acquise dans un environnement industriel ; une connaissance des secteurs aéronautique, spatial ou défense est fortement appréciée.
  • Maîtrise avancée de Power BI, DAX, Power Query et de la modélisation de données.
  • Bonne connaissance de SQL et des processus ETL.
  • Expérience des environnements SAP et compréhension des processus Supply Chain.
  • Capacité à intervenir en autonomie sur l'ensemble du cycle de développement d'une solution décisionnelle.


Compétences clés

  • Power BI Expert
  • DAX
  • Power Query (M)
  • SQL
  • ETL
  • Data Modeling
  • Data Visualization
  • SAP
  • Business Intelligence
  • Supply Chain Analytics
  • KPI Management
  • Optimisation des performances Power BI


Ce qui fera la différence

  • Une expertise reconnue dans le développement de solutions Power BI à forte volumétrie.
  • Une bonne compréhension des processus Achats et Supply Chain.
  • Une capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques.
  • Une approche structurée, orientée qualité des données et performance des solutions.
  • Une expérience dans un environnement industriel international.


Pourquoi nous rejoindre

Vous interviendrez sur une mission à forte valeur ajoutée, au cœur des enjeux de pilotage de la Supply Chain d'un grand groupe industriel.

Vous participerez à la conception d'outils décisionnels utilisés quotidiennement par les équipes opérationnelles et contribuerez directement à l'amélioration de la performance à travers la donnée.


Localisation

  • Toulouse
  • demarrage : septembre.
  • Mission principalement sur site,


Prérequis

  • Anglais professionnel indispensable : l'ensemble des échanges, de la documentation technique et des livrables est réalisé en anglais.
  • Être éligible aux habilitations et autorisations d'accès requises pour intervenir dans un environnement relevant des secteurs aéronautique, spatial et défense, incluant si nécessaire les habilitations de sécurité et les autorisations d'accès aux zones réglementées.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup transforming the industry — from enhancing guest experiences to driving business growth.

With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners, including Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia, and Google Travel, Guesty empowers property managers to deliver exceptional guest experiences while running efficient, data-driven operations.

Today, we're proud to have 800+ team members across 16 countries, all working together to shape the future of hospitality technology.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Marketing organization. This role will partner closely with Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver actionable insights, develop scalable reporting, analyze campaign performance, and help optimize marketing strategies through data. The ideal candidate has strong SQL expertise, experience with BI tools, and the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the primary analytics partner for the Marketing team.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards using Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI tools.
Analyze marketing performance across Google Ads, Facebook Ads, email, paid search, paid social, and organic channels.
Define, monitor, and report on key marketing KPIs, including ROI, ROAS, CAC, LTV, attribution, conversion rate, marketing spend, and campaign performance.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities through data analysis.
Partner with Marketing, Product, and Business teams to support strategic decision-making.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reporting accuracy across dashboards and reports.
Continuously improve reporting processes through automation and scalable analytics solutions.


Requirements:


3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Marketing Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Analyst.
Expert-level SQL skills with experience writing complex SQL queries (joins, CTEs, window functions, subqueries, aggregations, query optimization, and data transformation). This is a core requirement.
Strong experience using BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify actionable insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience building dashboards, reports, and executive-level presentations.
Experience defining and tracking KPIs and business metrics.
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong English communication skills.


Highly Preferred


Experience as a Marketing Data Analyst within a SaaS, IT, software, or technology company.
Experience with Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or similar marketing platforms.
Strong understanding of marketing metrics, including: ROI, ROAS, Attribution, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), Marketing Spend, Conversion Rate
Experience supporting B2B SaaS marketing teams.
Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift.
Experience with Python or R for data analysis is an advantage.
Experience with AI tools or analytics automation is a plus.


Join us and discover a workplace where career growth, collaboration, and enjoyment can all exist together.

﻿

People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Analysts and Scientists work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering smart, scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who can dig into our complex databases, look for the root cause of a problem, and design their own solutions by writing code to implement them.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

Working on ETL processes
Creating and maintaining new aggregated views and tables to simplify data querying
Automating analytics, including P&L attribution, daily risk reporting, and short-term investments performance
Performing behavioural liquidity and cash flow analysis
Analysing ad-hoc performance enhancements
Undertaking model-based performance optimisation


What You'll Need


Experience in an analytical role supporting a markets-based business, or at a major financial institution, asset manager, or liquidity provider within a treasury or risk role (FTP, ALM, IRRB, etc.)
A bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline
Impeccable data manipulation and analysis skills with Python and SQL
Evidence of solid mathematical and statistics knowledge
Fluency in English


Nice to have


An advanced degree in a STEM subject
To have participated in university Olympic medal competitions in physics, maths, economics, or programming

Description:
Power BI Support Resources




Location: Dublin 2

Work mode- Hybrid (5 days per week (min 3 days in office)

Contract Type: 24 Months

Start Date: Early October 2026

Daily Rate: Strong Day Rate




Overview

PFH Technology is partnering directly with a Dublin-based client to appoint an experienced Power BI Support Resource with strong expertise in Power BI administration, dashboard development, reporting, analytics and data integration. The successful candidate will support business stakeholders, engage with data owners and deliver scalable, secure and high-quality Power BI solutions within a structured project environment.




Experience & Qualifications

6+ years of substantial professional experience in their specialised field.
A trusted performer on a wide range of client-facing consultancy projects in either the private and public sectors.
Ability to participate in multi-disciplinary teams and to work independently (with limited supervision).
Performs professional level analysis requiring technical skills and independent initiative within a well-defined programme of work.
Senior team leader with the ability to deputise for the senior responsible person and coach and mentor more junior staff.
Contacts with clients predominantly at a working level.
Can engage with clients at strategic/management level if required.
Equivalent of at least 4 to 6 years relevant work experience with Power BI Applications (mandatory).
A degree (Level 8 QQI) in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or relevant related discipline (mandatory).




Key Experience / Competencies / Skillsets

Experience in publishing Power BI dashboards for organisational and public use.
Experience in the administration of Power BI dashboards regarding access to the dashboard and ensuring data refresh is up to date.
Experience in the use of varied data sources including Database/Data Warehouse, Atlassian Jira and external websites.
Experience in the use of APIs to access data from a variety of sources including Database/Data Warehouse, Atlassian Jira and external websites.
Experience in providing data that is accurate, congruent and reliable, and ensuring information is available for direct consumption or integration with other systems.
Ability to review available data, search and identify patterns that could indicate new insights.
Experience in writing and providing documentation including functional specifications, technical specifications, user guides and supporting documentation.
Experience of end-to-end project completion including designing, testing, building and demonstrating best-in-class models, dashboards and visualisations using Microsoft Power BI.
Experience of working within a Public Service Body to develop insights for data-driven policy development.




Key Deliverables

Provide administration support on the Power BI platform.
Act as a subject matter expert for Power BI administration and development when required.
The provision of regular project status reports to management.
Liaise with business owners to monitor and report on project progression.
Identify data requirements and data sources and engage with data owners and stakeholders to ensure data access and ingestion.
Assist with the design and/or development of new data products including statistical models, dashboards, data visualisations and query tools.
Demonstrate and make available high quality and best in class data products internally and externally.
Presentation of findings through reports, dashboards and visualisation tools to key stakeholders.
Write and provide documentation including functional and technical specifications and user guides.
Maintenance and support of analytical products throughout their life cycle.




About PFH Technology

PFH Technology, owned by Ricoh – a globally recognised Japanese ICT organisation – is a leading provider of end-to-end ICT solutions and managed services across Ireland. With a strong nationwide presence and a team of over 750 dedicated professionals, PFH Technology delivers innovative cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and managed service solutions for SMEs and large enterprise organisations.




Note: No visa sponsorship is available for this role.




Website: www.pfh.ie

Title: Data Analyst (Finance)
Description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Analysts and Scientists work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering smart, scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who can dig into our complex databases, look for the root cause of a problem, and design their own solutions by writing code to implement them.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You’ll Be Doing


Working on ETL processes
Creating and maintaining new aggregated views and tables to simplify data querying
Automating analytics, including P&L attribution, daily risk reporting, and short-term investments performance
Performing behavioural liquidity and cash flow analysis
Analysing ad-hoc performance enhancements
Undertaking model-based performance optimisation


What You'll Need


Experience in an analytical role supporting a markets-based business, or at a major financial institution, asset manager, or liquidity provider within a treasury or risk role (FTP, ALM, IRRB, etc.)
A bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline
Impeccable data manipulation and analysis skills with Python and SQL
Evidence of solid mathematical and statistics knowledge
Fluency in English


Nice to have


An advanced degree in a STEM subject
To have participated in university Olympic medal competitions in physics, maths, economics, or programming


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.


Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join us as Data Analyst

Function: Customer Development

Reports to: Business Intelligence Lead

Scope: Belgium and Netherlands

Location: CityDox in Belgium / Rotterdam in Netherlands, with ability to travel to the other country once per week according to business needs.

Terms & Conditions: Full-Time / Permanent contract.

Job Purpose

This role exists to transform data into meaningful insights that drive business decisions and continuous improvement. The Data Analyst leads the full lifecycle of data analysis, including requirements gathering, analysis, reporting, and solution design. The role is responsible for developing the organization's analytical and reporting capabilities, monitoring performance, identifying opportunities for improvement, and enabling data-driven decision making. By retrieving, processing, and analyzing large volumes of data, the Data Analyst delivers actionable insights that support business growth and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities


Interpret data, analyze results using statistical techniques, and provide ongoing reports.
Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex datasets.
Develop and implement databases, data collection systems, data analytics, and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and data quality.
Acquire data from primary and secondary sources and maintain databases and data systems.
Work closely with management and agile squads to prioritize business and information needs.
Clean, structure, and validate data to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Perform reporting and direct analysis to generate actionable and valuable business insights.
Develop dashboards, visualizations, and reporting solutions to support decision-making.
Monitor performance indicators and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Support data-driven initiatives by translating business requirements into analytical solutions.


Required Qualifications


Experience in data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence.
Strong analytical skills, with excellent knowledge of Power BI.
Fluency in Dutch is a must and French is a plus.
Strong communication and public speaking skills with great ability to present and explain data.
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets.
Proactivity and passion to take the initiatives.
Experience working with databases, data extraction, and data visualization tools.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience of 0-5 years in a junior position.
Experience working in Agile environments and cross-functional teams.
Knowledge of statistical analysis methodologies and predictive analytics.


Additional Information

Work location and conditions:


CityDox in Belgium / Rotterdam in Netherlands, with ability to travel to the other country once per week according to business needs.
Hybrid module.


Please be aware if you are applying for this role from outside the BeNeLux (Belgium/Netherlands/Luxembourg), while the location of the role is within the BeNeLux, if successful, your internal application will be treated as a self-initiated Change Location Outside of Country (CLOC) transfer.

Always include your CV in French or English. If the job needs another language, you can also additionally add your CV in that language.

We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! Thus if you require any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of your application so that we can support you through your recruitment journey.

Duration: Permanent

Company: Kingspan Data Solutions

About The Role

The Planet Passionate Data Analyst is responsible for supporting the governance, reporting, forecasting, and continuous improvement of the Planet Passionate programme across Kingspan Data Solutions. Working closely with the Divisional Planet Passionate Programme Manager, the postholder will ensure the accuracy, integrity, and completeness of sustainability data through robust controls, standardised processes, audit-ready documentation, and the development of reporting and forecasting tools.

The role will play a key part in improving visibility and reporting of performance across the division and business units, identifying risks and opportunities to target achievement, and supporting the onboarding and integration of acquisitions and new businesses into the Planet Passionate framework.

Key Responsibilities


Own the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of Planet Passionate data reporting across all sites, business units, and regions.
Develop and maintain robust data governance processes, controls, validation checks, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistency and audit readiness.
Produce high-quality monthly Planet Passionate performance reports at site, business unit, regional, and divisional level, tailored to the needs of each audience and readily usable for business review meetings.
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Planet Passionate forecasting models, identifying performance gaps, risks, and opportunities against targets.
Support Planet Passionate audit readiness through evidence management, documentation control, and maintenance of auditable reporting processes.
Lead the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Planet Passionate dashboards, reporting tools, forecasting models, data validation systems, and automation initiatives.
Support the development, implementation, and enforcement of Planet Passionate standards, procedures, controls, and reporting practices across the division.
Support the validation and integration of PG&S and procurement data into Planet Passionate reporting and forecasting processes to improve performance visibility and strategic decision-making.


Qualifications & Experience

Title: Data Analyst Intern
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

YOUR MISSION

You will be at the heart of Glovo's Global Logistics and Operations team, owning the data work behind how we design, test, and optimize the order compensation structures that reward our riders across 23 countries. This is one of the highest impact areas in the company, rider payments are our largest operational cost, and every model you build or experiment you run translates directly into business outcomes at scale.

The environment is fast moving. Priorities shift and ad hoc requests come in regularly. This internship is built for someone curious, hands-on, and eager to learn how real operational decisions get made with data. You will be paired with experienced analysts who will mentor you along the way.

THE JOURNEY


Support the team in modelling and reviewing order payment structures that improve engagement and operational efficiency.
You will be using SQL to query large datasets to surface trends, answer business questions quickly, and build the analytical foundation for strategic decisions.
Translate findings into action. You will help present insights to non-technical stakeholders in a way that is concise and convincing.
Support the design and running of experiments that validate setting changes before global rollout. You will be exposed to the full cycle: design, execution, and analysis.
Leverage AI in your workflow. You will actively incorporate AI tools (agents, copilots, and LLM-assisted analysis) into your day to day work to move faster and work smarter.
Monitor and iterate. Track KPIs, spot anomalies, and make data driven adjustments on an ongoing basis.
Understand the rider perspective to ensure models are fair, locally relevant, and operationally sound.


Qualifications

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE


Recently completed a degree or master's in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or another quantitative field.
SQL is essential. You can write queries to pull and filter data, join tables, and aggregate results on your own.
Python familiarity. You can use pandas (or similar) to manipulate data and automate simple tasks.
Excel / spreadsheet familiarity. You know your way around formulas, pivot tables, and structuring data cleanly.
Strong problem-solving instincts. You can take an ambiguous question, break it down, and work toward a clear answer without waiting to be told exactly how.
Fluent English is a must. You communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Nice-to-haves


Hands-on experience leveraging AI in your workflow: copilots, agents, or LLM-assisted analysis used to move faster and work smarter.
Exposure to data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
Any exposure to experimentation (A/B testing, switchback tests, or similar).


We Believe Driven Talent Deserves


🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!
💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.
🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!
👪 Enhanced parental leave, and office-based nursery.
🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being.

Sharp attention to detail, a proactive mindset and strong stakeholder skills

Title: DATA ANALYST POWER BI
Description:
Data Analyst Power BI – Eurostars Hotel Company




Desde Eurostars Hotel Company, compañía líder en el sector turístico y hotelero, buscamos un/a Data Analyst especializado/a en Power BI para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de Data en nuestras oficinas de Vigo.




La persona seleccionada trabajará junto a Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Scientists y equipos de negocio para transformar datos en información útil, visual, accionable y fácil de entender. El objetivo principal del rol será construir y mantener informes, dashboards y modelos semánticos que ayuden a las áreas de negocio a tomar mejores decisiones.







El rol de Data Analyst Power BI




Entender las necesidades de negocio y traducirlas en informes, cuadros de mando y visualizaciones claras en Power BI.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards orientados a negocio, especialmente en el ámbito hotelero: ventas, ocupación, revenue, reservas, clientes, canales, campañas, operaciones y rentabilidad.
Crear y mantener modelos semánticos en Power BI, asegurando una estructura de datos sólida, reutilizable y fácil de explotar por los usuarios.
Definir métricas, KPIs y reglas de negocio junto con los equipos funcionales.
Trabajar con datos procedentes de diferentes sistemas corporativos, asegurando coherencia, calidad y trazabilidad.
Desarrollar medidas en DAX y transformar datos con Power Query cuando sea necesario.
Construir visualizaciones claras, útiles y bien diseñadas, adaptadas al perfil de cada usuario.
Ayudar a los equipos de negocio a interpretar los datos y extraer conclusiones accionables.
Participar en la evolución de la capa analítica de la compañía, proponiendo mejoras en modelos, informes y procesos de reporting.




Requisitos mínimos




Experiencia trabajando como Data Analyst, BI Analyst o perfil similar, al menos de un año.
Conocimientos sólidos de Power BI.
Experiencia creando modelos semánticos, relaciones entre tablas, medidas y KPIs.
Conocimientos de DAX.
Conocimientos de SQL y bases de datos relacionales.
Capacidad para entender necesidades de negocio y convertirlas en soluciones analíticas.
Criterio visual para crear informes claros, ordenados y orientados a la toma de decisiones.
Buena capacidad de comunicación con perfiles técnicos y no técnicos.




Valoraremos también




Experiencia previa en el sector hotelero, turístico, retail, revenue management o entornos con alta orientación comercial.
Conocimiento de métricas hoteleras.
Experiencia trabajando con modelos de datos corporativos o capas semánticas compartidas.
Conocimientos de Azure, Fabric, Synapse, o entornos cloud.
Capacidad para detectar inconsistencias en los datos y proponer mejoras en la calidad de la información.




Lo que buscamos




Personas con mentalidad analítica y orientación a negocio.
Capacidad para hacer preguntas, entender el contexto y no limitarse solo a elaborar presentaciones o gráficos.
Cuidado por el detalle, tanto en el dato como en la presentación visual.
Autonomía, responsabilidad y ganas de aprender.
Buena comunicación y capacidad para explicar información compleja de forma sencilla.
