Title: Data Analyst (Finance)
Description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Analysts and Scientists ‌work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering smart, scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to support regulatory reporting. You'll work with complex data structures, adapting them to strict specifications, and ensure solutions are efficient and reliable.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You'll Be Doing


Supporting the Finance team with financial planning, treasury operations, financial strategy, and regulatory reporting
Building and adapting data models and ETL processes for regulatory reporting
Maintaining and improving reporting infrastructure, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and high data quality
Translating complex requirements into clear, efficient data solutions
Understanding our business and its processes through our data
Monitoring and improving data reliability, applying high attention to detail
Designing key metrics to measure different aspects of the business
Creating and maintaining new aggregated views and tables to simplify data querying
Maintaining and creating dashboards to track metrics and visualise insights
Collaborating closely with Regulatory Reporting Managers to understand reporting logic and operational processes


What You'll Need


4+ years experience with SQL, and a solid understanding of complex data systems
Experience in an analytical role, creating impactful solutions
Great collaboration skills to partner with Regulatory Reporting Managers and cross-functional teams
A background or education in a quantitative discipline
To be detail-oriented, quality-focused, and able to deliver under time constraints
Proficiency with Python or other programming languages
The ability to adjust data to strict regulatory specifications
Solid mathematical and statistics knowledge
A proactive mindset with sense of urgency


Nice to have


Experience in finance, banking, and/or accounting
An advanced degree in a core STEM subject
Proficiency with additional programming languages, such as Java, Scala, or C++
To have participated in school/university Olympiad competitions in physics, maths, economics, or programming


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.


Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

Title: DATA ANALYST - EXPERIENCIA DE CLIENTE
Description:
Descripción del puesto:

¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

Buscamos un Data Analyst para impulsar el desarrollo de la capa informacional del banco y aportar valor directo al negocio y a la dirección. Su misión será transformar datos - estructurados y no estructurados - en conocimiento útil que permita entender mejor el negocio, el mercado y nuestros clientes, así como identificar oportunidades de mejora y crecimiento.

La persona seleccionada formará parte de un equipo transversal y tendrá un rol clave como analista end‑to‑end, combinando análisis ad‑hoc, automatización de procesos, definición de KPIs, construcción de dashboards y participación activa en la migración de nuestros procesos y proyectos al entorno cloud.

Este rol es ideal para alguien con iniciativa, fuerte capacidad analítica, curiosidad y ganas de asumir un papel amplio y de impacto dentro del equipo.

 

Sus responsabilidades incluyen:

 

Gestión de la relación con los clientes (dirección y áreas de negocio)

Interlocución habitual con dirección y áreas de negocio para entender necesidades y traducirlas en soluciones basadas en datos.
Priorización y planificación de los proyectos y peticiones recurrentes.
Gestión de expectativas, seguimiento y comunicación de resultados.

 

Realización de proyectos en los que se aborda el ciclo completo de análisis de información

Toma de requerimientos de información de negocio
Exploración de datos en Datapool y/o fuentes externas. Desde la búsqueda hasta el tratamiento de los datos hasta generar la información necesaria
Propuesta y generación de KPIs
Construcción de los informes / análisis para presentar la información
Comunicación de resultados a los clientes
Diseño, elaboración, mantenimiento y automatización los procesos para seguimientos recurrentes o peticiones puntuales.

 

Para realizar estas funciones, será necesario:

Tener conocimientos técnicos para llevar a cabo los informes que se requieran desde negocio
Tener cualidades analíticas que permitan entender la lógica de negocio y proponer nuevas ideas o estrategias que ayuden a impulsarlo
Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales, así como creatividad y atención a los detalles en la visualización y comunicación de información.
Requisitos mínimos
Licenciatura en carreras de ciencias o ingenierías.
Fuertes capacidades de análisis y gestión de datos, con uso de herramientas de análisis y explotación de Bases de datos: alto nivel en SQL, fluidez en Data Discovery y Análisis Estadísticos, Python, GIT, Airflow.
Formación en lenguajes de programación.
Generación de dashboards con herramientas de visualización como QlikSense, Looker, etc.
Nivel avanzado herramientas de ofimática (Excel, Power Point, etc).

 

Se valorará positivamente:

Experiencia trabajando o analizando experiencia de cliente (NPS, touchpoints, etc.)
Experiencia previa en Google Cloud o en otras plataformas cloud (AWS, etc.).
Experiencia previa en Banca en departamentos de analítica/BI.

 

Competencias Clave

 

Gestión de grandes volúmenes de datos
Gestión de proyectos de información (relación con clientes y proveedores)
Capacidad de traducir requerimientos de negocio en especificaciones técnicas
Persona resolutiva, con entusiasmo y compromiso, colaborativa
Perfil flexible, con capacidad de adaptación al cambio
Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales
Orientación al negocio y a la experiencia de cliente
Definición y seguimiento de KPI’s comerciales

 

¿Qué ofrecemos?
Formar parte del Banco más innovador en Europa Occidental, según los premios The Innovators de la revista estadounidense Global Finance.
Programa de onboarding y acompañamiento personalizado para tu desarrollo profesional.
Itinerario formativo individual con acceso a nuestra plataforma online, que ofrece un extenso catálogo de recursos de autoaprendizaje para fomentar tu crecimiento continuo.
Dispondrás de un seguro de salud completo totalmente gratuito para ti. Además, quedarás adherido al Plan de Pensiones, al que CaixaBank realizará aportaciones pensando ya en tu futuro.
Retribución flexible aplicada a transporte, formación, idiomas, guardería, entre otros.
Medidas de flexibilidad (trabajo en remoto, flexibilidad entrada)
Contamos con la certificación Top Employer, que nos reconoce como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Descrizione azienda




Fides è una tech company che da vent’anni si contraddistingue sul mercato per una doppia offerta di servizio: partnership consulenziali con i più importanti system integrator internazionali e sviluppo di progetti IT custom.




Grazie a 20 anni di esperienza e oltre 300 risorse dislocate tra le sedi (Milano, Napoli, Roma e Torino), Fides si posiziona tra le principali aziende italiane Hi-tech.




Le competenze e i progetti Fides si estendono dal Banking & Finance, al Digital Retail, alle tecnologie per il Monitoraggio Ambientale, ai Servizi e Soluzioni ICT per l’Industry 4.0, per l’e-commerce e la logistica.




Posizione




Per un importante progetto in ambito Data & Analytics, siamo alla ricerca di un BI / Data Analyst con una solida esperienza nell’interrogazione, nell’integrazione e nella modellazione dei dati, affiancata da competenze avanzate nello sviluppo di report e dashboard.




La risorsa entrerà a far parte di un team specializzato nella gestione e valorizzazione del dato e sarà coinvolta nell’intero ciclo di sviluppo delle soluzioni di Business Intelligence: dall’acquisizione e trasformazione delle informazioni fino alla definizione dei KPI, alla modellazione dei dati e alla realizzazione degli strumenti di reporting.




Ti occuperai della gestione end-to-end dei flussi dati provenienti da fonti differenti, del monitoraggio della qualità delle informazioni e dello sviluppo di soluzioni di reporting performanti, accessibili e coerenti con le esigenze degli stakeholder di business.




Sarai inoltre coinvolto/a nel governo delle piattaforme di Business Intelligence, nella gestione degli accessi e degli aspetti di sicurezza, nel supporto agli utenti e nella produzione della documentazione funzionale e tecnica.




La modalità di lavoro sarà ibrida, con presenza richiesta presso l’ufficio di Milano almeno una volta a settimana.




Requisiti




Competenze tecniche




Esperienza nel ruolo di BI Analyst, Data Analyst o in posizioni analoghe in ambito Data & Analytics
Esperienza nella gestione end-to-end di flussi dati, incluse attività di integrazione, trasformazione e modellazione
Competenze avanzate nell’utilizzo di Power BI
Esperienza nella modellazione tabellare e nello sviluppo di misure e logiche tramite DAX
Conoscenza e utilizzo della Row-Level Security, RLS
Esperienza nello sviluppo, nella manutenzione e nell’ottimizzazione di report e dashboard
Conoscenza di JasperReports
Solida esperienza nella modellazione dati per soluzioni di Business Intelligence e Data Warehousing
Ottima conoscenza di Oracle e del linguaggio SQL
Conoscenza di PL/SQL
Esperienza con SQL Server

Title: Data Analyst- Modelos de Empresas- Barcelona
Description:
Somos Banco Sabadell




Somos el cuarto grupo bancario español. Pero, sobre todo, somos un equipo genuino de personas colaborando para ofrecer las mejores soluciones a nuestros clientes. En Banco Sabadell, #QueremosQueSeasTú, porque sabemos que el talento único de cada persona es lo que nos hace #SerSabadell. En estos momentos, estamos buscando un/una Data Analyst para la unidad de Modelos de Originación con la finalidad de participar en las iniciativas de la Dirección de Modelos de Empresas, con enfoque en el desarrollo y seguimiento de modelos de originación.




Los proyectos en los que participarás destacan por su transversalidad entre las unidades de riesgos y negocio y tienen como principal objetivo asegurar el buen performance de los modelos así como la evolución y mejora de los mismos.




Hablemos del proyecto...







Misión







Analiza, supervisa y realiza el seguimiento de los diferentes KPIs definidos en los modelos para evaluar su performance en todas sus vertientes: calidad del dato, anticipación del impago, e impacto en el negocio del Banco. Evalúa mejoras y oportunidades, prepara análisis para la toma de decisiones de Negocio. Utiliza analítica avanzada para resolver problemas y generar un valor añadido con impacto en el Negocio. Colabora con los diferentes departamentos para asegurar el cumplimiento de los diferentes KPIs establecidos de acuerdo con la estrategia de Negocio y la supervisión de segunda línea del Banco.







Funciones:







Seguimiento mensual de los modelos de preconcesión e identificación de mejoras para adaptarlos constantemente a la estrategia de negocio del Banco y a los requerimientos fijados por segunda línea.
Desarrollo de analítica avanzada para dar soluciones a las necesidades planteadas desde negocio. Para el desarrollo de modelos más avanzados se requerirá principalmente Python.
Elaboración de análisis e interpretación de los resultados obtenidos que apoyarán la toma de decisiones. El tratamiento de datos se realizará principalmente en SAS.
Elaborarás entregables y documentos que serán compartidos dentro de la Dirección así como el reporting y seguimientos de los modelos para segunda línea del Banco.
Defenderás y argumentarás las diferentes mejoras propuestas en los modelos frente a segunda línea del Banco y otras direcciones.
Liderarás/ Dinamizarás las líneas de trabajo incluidas en las iniciativas.




¿Qué valoramos de tu candidatura?




Grado / Máster en Estadística, Matemáticas, Ingeniería o similar.
Experiencia en modelización estadística y machine learning.
Experiencia y agilidad en programación con SAS para el tratamiento de bases de datos.
Dominio de algún lenguaje de programación orientado a la modelización. Especialmente valorable Python.
Nivel medio de Excel y presentaciones en Power Point
Conocimientos de la estructura de la entidad y del negocio.
Actitud proactiva, orientación a resultados, creatividad ante la resolución de problemas, capacidad analítica y muchas ganas de adquirir un nuevo rol dentro de la unidad.
Valorable nivel B1/B2 de inglés.







Banco Sabadell está comprometido en promover ambientes de trabajo en los que se trate con respeto y dignidad a las personas, procurando el desarrollo profesional de la plantilla y garantizando la igualdad de oportunidades en su selección, formación y promoción ofreciendo un entorno de trabajo libre de cualquier discriminación por motivo de género, edad, orientación sexual, religión, etnia o cualquier otra circunstancia personal o social.

Banco Sabadell forma parte de la red de empresas con el distintivo de "Igualdad en la Empresa" otorgado por el Ministerio de Igualdad.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst, Python & SQL - Energy Trading & Optimization, Amsterdam (Hybrid)

Our client is an Amsterdam based energy trading and optimization company on a mission to accelerate the energy transition. The company has grown to over 40 people, with a 12 person tech organization split across software, infrastructure, and data teams.




You'll join a 3 person data team (a Team Lead and two Data Engineers) as the team's 4th member and its first dedicated Data Analyst. You'll work in a fully AWS-based environment, primarily using Python and PostgreSQL, turning incoming market and forecasting data into insight that directly supports trading decisions. This is a long-term, end-to-end project: you'll take ownership of making the underlying data accurate, validated, and usable for the business, with room to grow into more responsibility as a medior analyst.




The role is a mix of analysis and engineering, roughly 75/25: validating and benchmarking incoming data from external providers (including meteorological and energy market data), extracting insights from time series data, building dashboards, and shaping the data pipelines that feed the business's forecasting and trading strategies.




Team

3 people including the lead: 1 Team Lead, 2 Data Engineers. This hire becomes the 4th.




Tech stack

Python, PostgreSQL, AWS (Timestream and DynamoDB experience a plus), Docker and a bit of

Kubernetes a nice to have.




What we're looking for

3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst.
Strong Python skills for data analysis.
Hands-on SQL experience, particularly PostgreSQL.
Experience working in a cloud environment, specifically AWS.
An affinity for data engineering, and comfort with a role that's roughly 75% analysis and 25% engineering.
A proactive self-starter who takes initiative and can work independently.
Knowledge of the energy market is a plus.




Hours and hybrid

Full time, 40 hours per week. 3 days per week in the Amsterdam office, Monday and Friday compulsory, third day flexible.




Salary & contract

55 – 60 K range depending on experience.




Package

Fully covered travel allowance (NS Traject Vrij).
Sports subscription (up to €200/year).
Udemy account plus additional learning budget on request.
Monthly social activities.
Pension contribution.




Interview Process

Phone screening, take home assessment (one week to complete), final interview with the Data Team.




Interested? Please contact me at j.vanbaalen@doghouse.nl

We accelerate sustainable mobility. We obsess over partnerships. We grow relentlessly: our network, our partners, ourselves.

If you're here, you're probably not looking for "just a job." Neither are we. 😎 We're driven by impact, and always looking for people who thrive on turning bold ideas into reality. If that sounds like you, you'll feel at home here. We're looking for people who see challenges as puzzles, not problems, thrive in fast-growing, high-energy environments, and want to shape the future of mobility, not just watch it unfold. At Powerdot, you'll get freedom, ownership, and responsibility. The space to experiment. The chance to scale your ideas. And a team that's always pushing the edge of what's possible.

🚀 About This Role

As our Data Analyst, you'll be part of the Central Data team at Powerdot and will play a key role in the current phase of accelerated growth. Your mission is to transform raw data into clear, actionable insights that power smarter decisions across the business — ensuring every team has the visibility they need to move fast and move well. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

How You'll Shape Our Story:

Your day-to-day will include

Gathering and transforming data from a variety of sources — including internal databases, external APIs, and surveys, ensuring data is ready for analysis.

Developing data visualizations — creating clear, compelling dashboards and reports that communicate findings to stakeholders in a concise and actionable way.
Partnering with stakeholders — understanding their needs and developing data-driven solutions that address real business questions.
Championing data quality — maintaining and supporting a culture of strong data quality across teams and workflows.
Staying ahead of analytics trends — keeping up-to-date on the latest tools, techniques, and best practices in data analytics.
Mentoring colleagues — coaching co-workers on analytics best practices and helping elevate the team's overall data capability.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:

Up to 4 years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you know how to break down complex questions and find the signal in the noise.
Technical proficiency — familiar with SQL, Python, and at least one data visualization tool such as Tableau, Metabase, or Power BI.
Eagerness to learn and develop — you thrive in a fast-moving environment and proactively grow your skills.
Great communication skills — you can translate technical findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and complexity — you navigate unstructured problems with ease and bring clarity to chaos.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team — you're self-driven but collaborative when it counts.

The Kind of Energy We're Looking For:

We're not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We're into people who make things happen.

You lead and listen. Whether you're steering the ship or rowing alongside the crew, you bring others with you and keep communication wide open.
You own your stuff. You don't wait for instructions: you see an opportunity, grab it, and make it better than anyone expected.
You've got a green heartbeat. Sustainability isn't just cool, it's core. You care about doing work that leaves the world a little better than you found it.
You balance hustle with humanity. You love the buzz of in-person teamwork, but you also know when to recharge (pun totally intended 🔋).
You grow on purpose. You're hungry to learn, to stretch, and to build something meaningful, not just rack up LinkedIn bullet points.

How you'll be Powered up?

🏥 Private health insurance coverage
💪🏼 Gym membership to help you stay active
⏰ Flexible working hours: you own your time
🌍 Annual offsite where we celebrate the year's achievements and spend quality time together (this year we went to Algarve, Portugal!)
🤝🏼 Regular team-building events with your local teammates
📚 English Training — as English is our language used to connect with all markets and teams
🍩 Free office snacks and unlimited coffee & Meal allowance for every worked day
⚡️ Special discounts for charging your electric vehicle

Our Promise To You

The best solutions come from different voices. We're building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity aren't policies — they're lived every day. At Powerdot, everyone has the space to speak up, challenge the status quo, and make a difference. Your voice powers the future — literally.

¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

Buscamos un Data Analyst para impulsar el desarrollo de la capa informacional del banco y aportar valor directo al negocio y a la dirección. Su misión será transformar datos - estructurados y no estructurados - en conocimiento útil que permita entender mejor el negocio, el mercado y nuestros clientes, así como identificar oportunidades de mejora y crecimiento.

La persona seleccionada formará parte de un equipo transversal y tendrá un rol clave como analista end‑to‑end, combinando análisis ad‑hoc, automatización de procesos, definición de KPIs, construcción de dashboards y participación activa en la migración de nuestros procesos y proyectos al entorno cloud.

Este rol es ideal para alguien con iniciativa, fuerte capacidad analítica, curiosidad y ganas de asumir un papel amplio y de impacto dentro del equipo.

Sus Responsabilidades Incluyen

Gestión de la relación con los clientes (dirección y áreas de negocio)


Interlocución habitual con dirección y áreas de negocio para entender necesidades y traducirlas en soluciones basadas en datos.
Priorización y planificación de los proyectos y peticiones recurrentes.
Gestión de expectativas, seguimiento y comunicación de resultados.


Realización de proyectos en los que se aborda el ciclo completo de análisis de información


Toma de requerimientos de información de negocio
Exploración de datos en Datapool y/o fuentes externas. Desde la búsqueda hasta el tratamiento de los datos hasta generar la información necesaria
Propuesta y generación de KPIs
Construcción de los informes / análisis para presentar la información
Comunicación de resultados a los clientes
Diseño, elaboración, mantenimiento y automatización los procesos para seguimientos recurrentes o peticiones puntuales.


Para Realizar Estas Funciones, Será Necesario


Tener conocimientos técnicos para llevar a cabo los informes que se requieran desde negocio
Tener cualidades analíticas que permitan entender la lógica de negocio y proponer nuevas ideas o estrategias que ayuden a impulsarlo
Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales, así como creatividad y atención a los detalles en la visualización y comunicación de información.


Requisitos mínimos


Licenciatura en carreras de ciencias o ingenierías.
Fuertes capacidades de análisis y gestión de datos, con uso de herramientas de análisis y explotación de Bases de datos: alto nivel en SQL, fluidez en Data Discovery y Análisis Estadísticos, Python, GIT, Airflow.
Formación en lenguajes de programación.
Generación de dashboards con herramientas de visualización como QlikSense, Looker, etc.
Nivel avanzado herramientas de ofimática (Excel, Power Point, etc).


Se Valorará Positivamente


Experiencia trabajando o analizando experiencia de cliente (NPS, touchpoints, etc.)
Experiencia previa en Google Cloud o en otras plataformas cloud (AWS, etc.).
Experiencia previa en Banca en departamentos de analítica/BI.


Competencias Clave


Gestión de grandes volúmenes de datos
Gestión de proyectos de información (relación con clientes y proveedores)
Capacidad de traducir requerimientos de negocio en especificaciones técnicas
Persona resolutiva, con entusiasmo y compromiso, colaborativa
Perfil flexible, con capacidad de adaptación al cambio
Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales
Orientación al negocio y a la experiencia de cliente
Definición y seguimiento de KPI’s comerciales


¿Qué ofrecemos?


Formar parte del Banco más innovador en Europa Occidental, según los premios The Innovators de la revista estadounidense Global Finance.
Programa de onboarding y acompañamiento personalizado para tu desarrollo profesional.
Itinerario formativo individual con acceso a nuestra plataforma online, que ofrece un extenso catálogo de recursos de autoaprendizaje para fomentar tu crecimiento continuo.
Dispondrás de un seguro de salud completo totalmente gratuito para ti. Además, quedarás adherido al Plan de Pensiones, al que CaixaBank realizará aportaciones pensando ya en tu futuro.
Retribución flexible aplicada a transporte, formación, idiomas, guardería, entre otros.
Medidas de flexibilidad (trabajo en remoto, flexibilidad entrada)
Contamos con la certificación Top Employer, que nos reconoce como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar

Title: Data & Business Operations Intern
Description:
What is Shotgun?

Shotgun is a leading platform dedicated to empowering live music event organizers and touring artists, driving the future of the live music industry. Our mission is to build the infrastructure that enables live music to thrive.

We provide powerful tools to sell tickets, build strong brands, and connect with fans in meaningful ways. From 2020 to 2025, Shotgun achieved rapid growth with GMV increasing 25× and revenue growing 40× — leading the company to profitability. Today, we support more than 10,000 clients and engage over 8,000,000 users across Europe, the US, and LATAM.

In the past seven years, Shotgun has raised €10M from Newfund, Venrex, One RagTime, Creator Collective, and BPI Culture Fund. We are a lean and dynamic team of 90 people, with offices in Paris, Miami, São Paulo, Lisbon, and Marseille. Our culture is built on passion, commitment, ownership, and humility.

What we're looking for

We're looking for individuals who want more than just a job. People willing to get out of their comfort zone to reach outstanding goals. Doers who never stop learning, are curious about everything and love solving problems. We want people who are talented, optimistic, and easy-going: who set the bar high but don't take themselves too seriously.

The Role

As Shotgun grows, so does our ambition. We're branching out into new territories, inaugurating fresh ventures, and, in the process, assembling new teams. Our pathway to success lies in our analytical rigor and exhaustive exploration of every opportunity.

As a Data & Business Operations Intern, you'll be embedded within the Business Operations & Strategy team. You will play a crucial role in scaling the operational teams. Your mission is to provide the processes, tools, datas and organizational frameworks that allow teams to scale efficiently and remain resilient in a growth context. You will also support business teams with robust business intelligence and data analytics insights to enable their potential.

What you will do

Operational processes & tooling


Identify potential improvements of the processes we use to solve common issues and propose creative and smart solutions.
Hack our tools stack to automate manual tasks to save time for (you) and other team members to work on impactful projects.
Handcraft no-code/low-code tools for organizers (that could become part of the Product one day) in order to test & gather feedback
Document and train other team members on the new tools and processes you came up with getting the infinite satisfaction of having others use your creation in their daily work.
Create and maintain tools to help the operational teams be more efficient (automation, macro etc.)
Maintain tools and processes so that everyone can keep on working seemlessly
Build and deploy internal AI-powered tools, write efficient prompts and contexts


Business intelligence & data analytics


Help us step back and understand our organisers performance (revenue they generate vs cost: marketing, support time etc.)
Run ad-hoc in depth data analysis to identify root cause of problems and qualify how bad they are (or not)
Assist Operational stakeholders (Support, Account Management, Marketing, Field ops…) with their BI needs and requests


The job is for you if


You are looking for a 6 months internship in Paris
You were born to solve problems
You like getting your hands dirty trying to help your team get better at what they do
You are about to graduate from an Engineering, Business School or University with a strong quantitative major
You have outstanding analytical skills
You are proactive, organized and you can work autonomously
You use AI on a daily basis
You master SQL/BI tools or are willing to master it. Experience with no code automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, etc.) is a plus.
You are fluent in French ; strong English is necessary; Portuguese is a plus.
You're eligible to work in France
Start date : Around January 2026 - Paris
👪 Note to women and underrepresented groups: We value diversity because it’s essential for creativity and healthy growth. If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements but are excited by this role, please apply 🙏

✈️ Team Offsites & Events: We invest in team moments because they matter
🕺 Shotgun Event Credits: Enjoy live events with quarterly credits
🏋️‍♀️ Egym Wellpass: Preferential rates for gyms and sports activities
🌱 Sustainable Mobility Bonus: For eco-friendly commuting like biking
🍔 Swile Lunch Card: Meals and more
💊 Alan Health Insurance: Full coverage for your health needs
👶 Childcare Support

Title: Data Analist Videoland
Description:
Jouw uitdaging

Als Data Analist bij Videoland speel je een belangrijke rol in het verbeteren van de ervaring van miljoenen gebruikers. Je zet data om in waardevolle inzichten die direct bijdragen aan de groei van ons platform. Door jouw analyses help je teams om betere beslissingen te nemen.




Wat ga je doen?

Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar impactvolle analyses en concrete aanbevelingen.
Je combineert en analyseert verschillende databronnen om trends, patronen en kansen te ontdekken.
Je vertaalt complexe data naar heldere inzichten en praktische adviezen voor stakeholders binnen Product, Marketing en andere B2C teams.
Je presenteert jouw analyses en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier aan zowel kleine als grotere groepen.
Je denkt mee over de kwaliteit, structuur en beschikbaarheid van data en ziet verbeterkansen in de volledige dataketen: van dataverzameling tot analyse.
Je werkt nauw samen met andere data disciplines om businessbehoeften te vertalen naar schaalbare en toekomstbestendige data-oplossingen.




Wie ben jij?

Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en krijgt energie van het oplossen van complexe vraagstukken. Je kijkt verder dan de cijfers en weet data te vertalen naar inzichten waarmee teams direct aan de slag kunnen. Je bent proactief & communicatief sterk en hebt altijd de eindgebruiker voor ogen.

Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

Minimaal 4 jaar relevante werkervaring als Data Analist of een vergelijkbare functie.
Ervaring met het analyseren en combineren van verschillende databronnen.
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.
Ervaring met moderne data- en AI-tools, zoals Snowflake, Python en Claude of vergelijkbare technologieën.
Uitgebreide kennis van SQL.
Affiniteit met digitale producten, streamingdiensten en de Nederlandse entertainmentmarkt.
Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte en oplossingsgerichte instelling.
Het vermogen om prioriteiten te stellen en analyses om te zetten in concrete verbeteringen.




Zo ziet de sollicitatieprocedure eruit

We vinden het belangrijk dat jij een goed beeld krijgt van de rol, het team en Videoland. Tegelijkertijd willen we ontdekken hoe jij denkt, samenwerkt en complexe vraagstukken aanpakt.

De procedure bestaat uit twee gesprekken:

Kennismakingsgesprek (1 uur) – We leren elkaar kennen en vertellen je meer over de rol, het team en Videoland.
Experience Interview (1 uur) – We gaan dieper in op jouw ervaring, werkwijze en de impact die je hebt gemaakt.

Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring kan hier nog een technische case aan worden toegevoegd. Hierbij zijn we niet op zoek naar perfecte antwoorden, maar vooral naar hoe je denkt, communiceert en tot oplossingen komt.




Wat krijg je van ons?

Een salaris tussen € 4.500 en € 5.400 bruto per maand op basis van een 40-urige werkweek, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.
Een aantrekkelijke winstuitkering.
200 vakantie-uren.
Een bijdrage aan je aanvullende zorgverzekering.
Een abonnement op Videoland.
Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en doorgroeimogelijkheden.
De kans om te werken aan een product dat dagelijks door miljoenen Nederlanders wordt gebruikt.




Jouw team

Je komt terecht in een hecht en ambitieus team van vier Data Analisten, een CRO Specialist en Team Manager. Samen hebben jullie één missie: Videoland laten uitgroeien tot het grootste en beste streamingplatform van Nederland. Dat doen we door data centraal te stellen in onze beslissingen, continu te experimenteren en nauw samen te werken met Product, Marketing, Tech en andere disciplines. We geloven in open communicatie, kennis delen en elkaar iedere dag een beetje beter maken.

Ben jij enthousiast geworden over deze functie? Solliciteer dan uiterlijk 26 augustus. Alleen sollicitaties die vóór deze datum zijn ontvangen, nemen we mee in de selectieprocedure.

We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie en hopen je snel te ontmoeten!

Title: Data Analyst II-Digital Analytics
Description:
Job Title: Senior Digital Analyst

Work Model: Hybrid, Framingham MA

This Senior Digital Analyst will be responsible for driving insights and recommendations related to the end-to-end purchasing customer journey for Staples B2C and B2B digital strategy across both Web and App platforms. This role requires an excellent collaborator, communicator, and analyst with extensive hands-on data experience. The successful candidate is a problem solver in a fast-moving and highly diverse environment and will be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring accuracy and timeliness are not compromised. In addition to strong analytical skills, the Analyst must be adept at communicating findings to senior leadership and business stakeholders across the organization in both verbal and presentation formats.

What you will be doing:


Work closely with Product Management and Digital Experience partners to provide insights and recommendations to improve the end-to-end purchase customer journey, inclusive of the Web and App experiences.
Be the subject matter expert on A/B testing and other experiment methods, providing consultative support and ensuring campaigns are set up to deliver accurate data collection and robust impact measurement.
Build self-service reporting so Analytics and stakeholders have full visibility into how customers are engaging with the site experiences teams own, and are able to identify opportunities for improving the customer experience.
Use your keen analytical skills and business acumen to help solve complex problems, communicate insights, and advance our reporting capabilities.


What You Bring to the Table:


We are looking for a collaborative, intellectually curious problem-solver who thrives in a customer-centric, agile environment.
Strong interpersonal skills, excellent communication and presentation abilities, and critical thinking are essential.
You should be able to break down complex problems, present data in clear, compelling ways, and work effectively with diverse teams.


What’s needed: Basic Qualifications:


Bachelor’s Degree (BA/BS) in Data Analysis, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field or equivalent work experience
2+ years of demonstrated experience as a Data Analyst or related role
2+ years of experience with A/B testing and other experimentation methods (such as pre/post, synthetic control, multi-armed bandits, etc.)
2+ years of experience with data querying / processing languages such as SQL, and Python / R
2+ years of experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, etc.), experience with Adobe Analytics is a plus.


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s degree in related field
Experience in predictive modeling and machine learning


We Offer: 


Inclusive culture with associate-led Business Resource Groups  
Flexible PTO (22 days) and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays)  
Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more! https://careers.staples.com/Staples-Life/Benefits


The salary range represents the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. The specific base pay may be influenced by a variety of factors to include the candidate's experience, skill set, education, geography, business considerations, and internal equity. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, or other forms of variable compensation.

Title: Analyst, Data and Analysis
Description:
Company Description

Digitas is the Networked Experience Agency, built on the vision that we create magnetic experiences that earn the right for brands to exist in human networks. Today, and tomorrow. We deliver Networked Experiences by leveraging comprehensive data, technology, creative, media and strategy capabilities. Digitas delivers ambitious outcomes via unique solutions that include Creative Experiences, Integrated Media, Addressable Relationships, Social Marketing and Total Commerce. Celebrated by Ad Age as Data and Insights Agency of the Year, U.S Campaign’s Brand Experience Agency of the Year, Media Network of the Year and celebrated by Forrester and Gartner, Digitas serves the world’s leading brands through a global network comprised of more than 5,500 employees across over 65 offices in 43 countries.

The Digitas culture is made up of fearless, inventive and generous Unicorns of all kinds.

Overview

The Data & Analysis team uses data-driven insights to fuel strategic growth for clients. We believe that data should never exist in a vacuum; instead, it should be put to work to bring the best ideas and stories to our clients.

To help with this, we’re looking for an outstanding Analyst – someone who has a knack for understanding data and telling the story of why it matters. You’ll learn from the best in the business as you work with the team to bring actionable insights to our clients. Up for it? Read on.

Responsibilities

As an Analyst, you’ll lay the groundwork and contribute to day-to-day reporting needs for client marketing efforts. You’ll work on brand campaigns, acquisition campaigns, site optimization, and/or online testing strategy.

Day-to-day, Your Role Includes


Keeping a pulse on day-to-day performance data, including display media, site, search, email, and/or social campaigns
Working in a variety of reporting systems and databases for the creation of recurring reports and dashboards
Identifying nuances in data to optimize our clients’ business
Supporting marketing initiatives across project and campaign lifecycles, including measurement plans, primary and secondary research, and performance reporting
Expanding industry knowledge and relevant skillsets through internal training


Qualifications

We’re looking for strong, impactful work experience, which typically includes:


1-3 years of work experience in a relevant industry
A four-year college degree
Passion for digital marketing, eagerness to learn in a constantly-changing space, and a natural curiosity
Familiarity with Excel and/or other data analysis tools such as SQL or Tableau a plus
Comfortable in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment
Familiarity with prompt-based interaction and commonly used generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Google Gemini, DALL·E, Midjourney) is a plus, especially for tasks like ideation, research, or content generation.


Got the sparkle? Apply if you believe your unique skills are a fit. We’d love to hear from you.

Additional Information

Digitas is an equal opportunity employer.

Compensation Range: USD $55,765.00 - USD $82,208.00/Annually. This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Temporary roles may be eligible to participate in our freelancer/temporary employee medical plan through a third-party benefits administration system once certain criteria have been met. Temporary roles may also qualify for participation in our 401(k) plan after eligibility criteria have been met. For regular roles, the Company will offer medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401k, and paid time off. The Company anticipates the application deadline for this job posting will be 9/1/2026.

Processing confidential data and information according to guidelines. Helping develop reports and analyses. Supporting initiatives for data integrity and normalization. Assessing tests and implementing new or upgraded software and assisting with strategic decisions on new systems. Generating reports from single or multiple systems. Troubleshooting the reporting database environment and reports. Evaluating changes and updates to source production systems. Training end-users on new reports and dashboards. Providing technical expertise in data storage structures, data mining, and data cleansing. Data Analyst Requirements: Bachelor s degree from an accredited university or college in computer science. Work experience as a data analyst or in a related field. Ability to work with stakeholders to assess potential risks. Ability to analyze existing tools and databases and provide software solution recommendations. Ability to translate business requirements into nontechnical, lay terms. High-level experience in methodologies and processes for managing large-scale databases. Demonstrated experience in handling large data sets and relational databases. Understanding of addressing and metadata standards. High-level written and verbal communication skills.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Purple Carrot

Founded in 2014, Purple Carrot delivers clean, long-lasting energy through the power of plants. As the only company in America devoted entirely to plant-based eating, we have spent over a decade perfecting the balance of protein and fiber that only plants can provide. Offering chef-crafted, dietitian-designed meals delivered right to your door, we make plant-forward eating effortless, flexible, and endlessly exciting. Our menu spans quick weeknight dishes, occasion-worthy dinners, breakfast, lunch, snacks, and ready-to-eat meals.

Purple Carrot prioritizes taste and flexibility, offering no membership fees, the freedom to skip or unskip weekly deliveries whenever you want, and a no-pressure, cancel-anytime policy. We pride ourselves on doing plants better than anyone else - and we have the receipts to prove it.

Description

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our mission-driven team. As an integral part of the Data department, you will join forces with the Sr. Manager, Data and Analytics (to whom you will also report) in our continued effort to inspire people to eat more plants!

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about transforming and analyzing complex datasets into clear, actionable, and timely insights that drive strategic decision-making and improve business results.

As the Senior Data Analyst, you will be focused on leveraging SQL, Python, and BI tools to identify opportunities, optimize key metrics, and measure performance across the organization. This is a high-visibility role that partners directly and frequently with senior leadership, translating data into high-quality analysis to support the decisions the business acts on. You'll also work closely with marketing and other teams across the organization to help them become proficient in the data assets you produce. You'll be part of a small data analytics team, so your work is visible, and your voice matters.

If you are a detail-oriented problem-solver who thrives at the intersection of data, analysis, and strategy, we'd like to meet you.

We greatly thank all applicants; however, only those under serious consideration will be contacted.


Location


This role is based in Dedham, MA, 3 days per week in the office
Our hybrid approach includes 3 in-office days each week, giving teams the best of both flexibility and collaboration. Many team members choose to come in more often - it's a great way to stay inspired and engaged with the team



On the Plate


Query and analyze large datasets to extract and communicate meaningful insights
Build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using SQL, Python, and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Omni, Sigma)
Build and apply machine learning models in Python — from predictive modeling (e.g., cancel/churn prediction, demand forecasting) to applied techniques (e.g., clustering, regression) that generate deeper analytical insight
Train and support teams on the data assets you build, so they have what they need to self-serve
Own forecasting and experimentation initiatives end-to-end, from framework design through measurement and recommendation
Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand what they actually need and provide data-driven solutions
Produce clear reports, visualizations, and presentations for leadership, with the ability to influence decisions without formal authority
Monitor and report on key performance indicators and emerging trends
Assist with ad hoc projects and tasks as necessary



Main Ingredients for the Role


3+ years' experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar analytical role
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science/Analytics) or equivalent experience
Able to commute to the Dedham, MA office 3 days/week
Proficient in SQL for data querying and transformation
Skilled in Python - for advanced analysis and automation, including building and running machine learning models
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Omni, Sigma)
Strong Excel skills for analysis and reporting



Extra Special Sauce

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!



Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.



What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!



Who we are:

Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments in higher education. We’ve since scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.



Today we support more than 5,100 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.



With over 1,200 global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 12 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.







Job Description



The Opportunity



We, at Flywire, are looking for a smart, analytical thinker who's excited to wow our clients with best in class data and analytics capabilities. As a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst, you will help set the vision and direction for how we communicate the story of Flywire's data to our clients, both with interactive in-app reporting solutions and custom analytics projects that speak to the unique value and ROI that our product has delivered throughout our partnership.



This is a true cross-functional role, with responsibilities crossing data & analytics, product development, relationship management, and sales. The ideal candidate will feel comfortable managing cross-functional projects and also have a deep technical understanding of a general BI stack and will be able to periodically contribute to development and analysis.



The responsibilities of the role include:



Help set a broad company vision for the way we communicate data and our value proposition to clients
Partner with business stakeholders to understand unique client situations and deliver analyses to show the value of Flywire's value and performance
Lead the design and development of customer-facing dashboards
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure that reporting and analytical solutions are secure, scalable, and part of a seamless user experience


Qualifications



Here's What We're Looking For



5-7 years of experience in business intelligence, product management, data and analytics, or a related field
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams
Strong experience with business intelligence tools is required, with a preference for Looker and Sigma
Comfortable presenting to both internal and external stakeholders
Strong communication skills: You can make even the most complex data easy to comprehend
Emerging data science and analytical skills
Familiar and comfortable with emerging AI technologies, digital assistants for natural language queries, and core LLM tools
Strong business acumen by connecting data and dashboard design decisions to revenue, client retention, and broader company strategy, not just technical execution
Experience working with finance-related data (revenue, billing, payments, or similar financial reporting) and translating it into stakeholder-ready insights
Experience working with client or CRM data (e.g. Salesforce) to build a unified view of client relationships and usage patterns


Additional Information



Submit today and get started!



We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager and other Flymates. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for questions.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $91,000 - $114,000, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, position level, and location. Title: Healthcare Data Analyst I
Description:
Position Summary

The Data Analyst is responsible for the development, organization, and maintenance of the study database, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and accessibility throughout the project. This role oversees data cleaning, quality assurance, and the implementation of standardized data management procedures to support accurate and reliable analyses. The Data Analyst also collaborates closely with the statistical team by preparing analysis-ready datasets, resolving data-related issues, and facilitating efficient communication between data management and statistical analysis to ensure the timely completion of study objectives.

Key Responsibilities


Research Database Development: Collaborate with the Principal Investigator (PI), Senior Scientist, and research assistants/coordinators to design, develop, and maintain a research database that aligns with the study objectives and data collection protocols. Ensure that the database structure supports accurate, efficient, and standardized data capture across all participating sites.
Data Entry Training and Education: Provide training and ongoing guidance to research assistants and coordinators on standardized data entry procedures, emphasizing the importance of accuracy, consistency, and adherence to the research protocol. Educate study personnel on the rationale behind key data elements to promote high-quality data collection that reflects the study objectives.
Data Quality Monitoring: Conduct routine data quality assessments to identify missing, inconsistent, or inaccurate data and ensure compliance with established data management standards. Work proactively with study personnel to resolve discrepancies in a timely manner and maintain the integrity of the research database throughout the study.
Data Cleaning and Preparation for Statistical Analysis: Perform comprehensive data cleaning, validation, and organization to create analysis-ready datasets for the statistical team. Collaborate closely with statisticians to ensure that datasets are accurately coded, well-documented, and formatted to facilitate efficient and reproducible statistical analyses.
Continuous Data Quality Improvement and Communication: Provide ongoing recommendations to improve database design, data collection procedures, and quality assurance processes based on routine monitoring and project needs. Maintain regular communication with the PI and Senior Scientist to identify opportunities for enhancing data quality, optimize workflow efficiency, and support the successful completion of study objectives.


Education

Minimum Qualifications


A Master’s degree is preferred.


Experience:


At least 1 year of data science, computer science, or data management experience in a healthcare system is preferred.


The posted pay range is Boston Children’s reasonable and good-faith expectation for this pay at the time of posting.

Any base pay offer provided depends on skills, experience, education, certifications, and a variety of other job-related factors. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive benefits package that includes flexible schedules, affordable health, vision and dental insurance, child care and student loan subsidies, generous levels of time off, 403(b) Retirement Savings plan, Pension, Tuition and certain License and Certification Reimbursement, cell phone plan discounts and discounted rates on T-passes. Experience the benefits of passion and teamwork.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Investment Data Analyst (Contract) | W2 ONLY

Contract Type: W2 Contract

Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid)

Industry: Investment Management

Employment Type: W2 Only

Strictly No C2C Arrangements




Apollo Solutions is partnered with an investment management firm who are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to support its investment data platform and front-office data operations.




This role is ideal for someone who understands how high-quality investment data underpins portfolio management, research, and trading decisions.




You'll play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of critical investment datasets while working closely with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, data engineering, and technology teams.




Responsibilities




Monitor and resolve investment data issues across reference data, market data, pricing, fundamentals, and corporate actions.
Analyse and validate complex corporate actions, ensuring downstream investment systems remain accurate.
Investigate data discrepancies, perform reconciliations, and determine business impact.
Support security master data, instrument identifiers, and cross-reference mappings across multiple data sources.
Build and maintain investment-ready datasets used by research and portfolio management teams.
Partner with engineering teams to improve data quality controls, validation rules, and monitoring processes.
Work with multiple financial market data providers to compare, validate, and enrich investment datasets.
Identify recurring data issues and contribute to long-term process improvements.
Collaborate with investment professionals to ensure data definitions align with real-world investment workflows.




Experience




Experience working with investment data within an institutional asset manager, hedge fund, asset owner, or quantitative investment environment.
Strong understanding of security reference data and identifiers such as ISIN, SEDOL, CUSIP, or FIGI.
Hands-on experience managing or analysing corporate actions.
Professional experience using SQL and Python for data analysis and validation.
Familiarity with leading financial data vendors such as Bloomberg, FactSet, Capital IQ, MSCI, ICE, CRSP, Worldscope, IBES, or similar platforms.
Experience developing or supporting data quality, reconciliation, or monitoring processes.
Understanding of investment workflows and how data supports portfolio management, research, or quantitative investing.
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to investigate and resolve complex data issues.
Strong communication skills and experience working across business and technology teams.
Experience supporting systematic or quantitative investment strategies.
Exposure to modern data platforms and orchestration tools.
Knowledge of portfolio analytics, factor data, or investment research processes.




If you have a passion for investment data and enjoy solving complex data challenges in a fast-paced investment environment, please apply with an updated resume.

Title: Machine Learning Analyst
Description:
Bracebridge Capital, LLC is a leading alternative asset manager with approximately $12 billion of net assets under management. The firm pursues investment strategies primarily within the global fixed income markets with the objectives of capital preservation and absolute return without significant correlation to equity, interest rate and foreign exchange markets. Established in 1994, Bracebridge manages private investment funds that serve endowments, foundations, pension funds and other institutional and high-net-worth investors.

Approximately 170 employees operate from our office located in Boston’s historic Back Bay. The entrepreneurial and collaborative culture at Bracebridge rewards and supports motivated, dedicated, enthusiastic and intellectually curious individuals. We believe our firm’s greatest asset is the people who work here.

We are seeking a Machine Learning Analyst to join the growing data analytics and machine learning team. The team’s primary mission is to develop machine learning systems to answer open-ended investment questions and support portfolio management decisions. The team works across the project lifecycle and technical stack, from ideation, understanding and analyzing data, hypothesis generation and testing, and model development all the way through to the deployment and maintenance of models and systems in production. Our work spans statistical modeling, classical machine learning, and modern AI and LLM techniques.

The Machine Learning Analyst’s primary responsibility will be to contribute to these efforts alongside other team members. Over time, you will develop the technical and domain expertise needed to take increasing ownership of individual components and ultimately end-to-end projects.

The work is highly collaborative and spans quantitative research, software engineering, and machine learning. Analysts work with other members of the machine learning team and portfolio managers to translate loosely defined investment ideas into practical tools and models. Successful candidates will have solid programming foundations, be comfortable translating between qualitative and quantitative descriptions of problems and be excited to build data analysis and machine learning systems against the backdrop of portfolio management.

Since the team works closely with trading floor personnel to assist with portfolio management decision-making, an interest in economic and financial markets is essential, but no specific prior experience is necessary.

This role is open to candidates available to begin in the near term, as well as students expecting to complete their undergraduate degree between Fall 2026 and Summer 2027. Start dates will be determined based on candidate availability and, for students, degree completion.

Responsibilities


Collaborate closely with Machine Learning team members, portfolio managers, and researchers to translate open-ended investment questions into well-defined analytical and machine learning problems
Develop and evaluate data-driven machine learning and quantitative models, including simulation- and optimization-based approaches, for investment-related problems
Contribute to maintaining existing models and analytic tools in production
Over time, take ownership of individual features and components and full projects
Clearly document and communicate methods, assumptions, results, and limitations of models to other researchers and trading professionals across the firm
Stay current with relevant new techniques and technologies in machine learning and artificial intelligence, particularly as they pertain to finance and investing


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in a rigorous quantitative field
0-2 years of experience through industry internships, undergraduate research or thesis, or substantial independent technical projects involving software development, data analysis, or machine learning
Proficiency in Python and familiarity with the Python data science stack (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, etc), with experience in other languages a plus
Experience working with and analyzing data from multiple sources and in multiple formats
Familiarity with machine learning and statistical modeling fundamentals, including model evaluation and experimental design
Demonstrated ability to independently scope and execute open-ended technical projects
Interest in financial markets, intellectual curiosity, and comfort in working on open-ended problems
Strong written and verbal communication skills


Current anticipated annual base salary range: $110,000 - $145,000

Base salary within the range will be determined by various factors including but not limited to the individual's experience, skills and qualifications.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Site: The General Hospital Corporation

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

The Division for Neuropsychiatry and Neuromodulation at the Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School, is seeking a full time Data Analyst for a series of exciting large-scale projects aimed at understanding circuit dynamics underlying neuropsychiatric disorders and their treatments. The laboratory is a multidisciplinary group conducting clinical, translational and basic human neuroscience research with healthy and neuropsychiatric populations, using device-based neuromodulation interventions (TMS, tDCS, ECT, DBS, etc.), neuroimaging, EEG, behavioral and clinical methods. The program includes the Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) clinical service, tightly integrated with our research mission, where we provide individualized treatments for neuropsychiatric patients.

Qualifications

Duties and Responsibilities

The Data Analyst responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:


Implement and support statistical analyses, machine learning models, and processing pipelines/scripts for behavioral, EEG and multimodal neuroimaging analysis, including resting‐state and task-based fMRI, DTI and volumetric data.
Assist in the creation of databases, query tools for data mining, and documentation on their effective use. Behavioral (RedCap, etc.) and neuroimaging databases (BIDS, XNAT, etc.) are emphasized.
Maintain quality control and integrity of neuroimaging and behavioral data by developing, implementing and overseeing data entry and QC protocols.
Implement web-based behavioral questionnaires (e.g. RedCap) and program behavioral tasks with presentation software (e.g. Psychophysics Toolbox, PsychoPy, Presentation).
Provide programming and analysis support for lab members.
Coordinate general lab computer/network administration (including data management and archiving).
Assist with the preparation of scientific reports and publications.
Provide technical and logistical support for in-person study visits (data collection) as needed.
Provide training and backup support for CRCs on various projects as needed.


Qualifications:

Additional Job Details (if applicable)


B.A., B.S. or equivalent with background in neuroscience, computer science, engineering or related fields. Masters or PhD degree preferred but not required. 2+ years of prior technical experience.
Proficient with multiple neuroimaging analysis platforms (e.g. HCP Pipeline and Workbench, FreeSurfer, SPM, FSL, AFNI, etc.).
Strong programming skills and comfort with diverse computing environments (Linux) required.
Strong background in statistics and statistical software scripting (R, Python preferred).
Strong background creating scientific figures and writing technical scientific reports.
Strong interpersonal skills and a high level of organization with careful attention to detail are absolutely required. This position requires a high degree of motivation and self‐sufficiency, although extensive training and supervision will be provided.
Experience with graph analyses, machine learning and modeling confer a significant advantage.
Graphic or Web design skills are considered a plus.

The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People-Focused, half Performance-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

Title: Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics and Insights
Description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

What does the team work on? 

The Revenue Analytics team sits at the intersection of advertising sales, marketing, and client services. We partner across the business to maximize yield, accelerate ad revenue growth, and improve operational efficiency. Our work blends strategic planning, rigorous data analysis, and modern tooling to optimize the monetization of advertising inventory and unlock actionable insights for our stakeholders. 

 

What is the role? 

We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics and Insights, to join our growing Revenue Operations team. The role is focused on using internal data and competitive insights to help drive sustainable growth of the ad sales team, in addition to handling activities that help our teams operate efficiently. This role requires strong analytical and stakeholder management skills, ideally paired with knowledge of the media and connected TV (CTV) space, to help advance the business. The Senior Analyst will partner with sales leadership to uncover key opportunities to drive revenue, craft and deliver regular business reviews, and leverage sales reporting infrastructure to extract insights on our most important partners. This position reports to the Director, Revenue Analytics and Insights. 

This position is a hybrid role, Monday – Thursday in office with the option to work from home on Friday. This position is based in Boston, Massachusetts. 

For Boston - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $119,000 - $126,000 annually. 

Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off. 

 

How will I use AI at Roku? 

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. 

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment. 

 

What are the responsibilities of the role? 
Leverage sales reporting infrastructure to extract new insights on our most important partners, helping to create a more informed perspective on opportunities and threats within the market 
Partner with sales leadership to uncover key opportunities to drive revenue; provide reporting to track outcomes around these opportunities 
Craft and deliver regular business reviews (e.g., QBRs) for sales leadership that help us understand the health and trajectory of our business 
Execute and optimize a slate of regularly scheduled activities, e.g., weekly sales forecasting, quarterly and annual planning, quota administration and sales compensation 
Work closely with other teams and stakeholders to make recommendations on new reporting infrastructure needed to ensure we are always ahead of the curve 
Develop the narrative around total opportunity that advertisers or verticals represent, including understanding topline marketing investment, how that investment breaks down by brand, formats, and more; monitor industry-wide trends to understand impact to advertisers and verticals 
Use third-party tools to fulfill requests initiated by the sales team; develop strategy for incorporating data into our broader reporting portfolio 
Take a focused but not siloed approach, working in partnership with the broader Revenue Operations team and other cross-functional stakeholders to push forward strategic initiatives that span our core pillars 

 

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku? 

3-5 years of experience in sales or revenue operations, ideally within the media industry 
Direct experience partnering with sales or other go-to-market teams and supporting executive leadership 
Familiarity with the broader advertising landscape or ideally the connected TV (CTV) space 
Ability to use data to tell a story; comfortable preparing executive-level materials 
Advanced Excel capabilities, e.g., scenario modeling, macros 
Working experience with BI/visualization tools, e.g., Tableau, Looker, and real-world application of AI into work 
Deep understanding of data, hierarchies and relationships, and how they relate to business metrics and KPIs 
High degree of drive and self-motivation and comfort working autonomously 
Strong interpersonal and communication skills; comfort working at all levels of a sales organization 
Ability to thrive in a dynamic work environment, exhibiting flexibility and strong teamwork 
Excellent organizational and prioritization skills with attention to detail, and ability to work on many tasks concurrently 
Working knowledge of sales terminology and metrics 
Experience supporting several functional organizations (for example both sales and services); knowledge and understanding of key metrics driving a sales environment 
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience 

 

 

 

 

 

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

 

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

 

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

 

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.
