Title: Clinical Data Analyst II
Description:
Responsibilities

Job Summary

The Senior Clinical Data Analyst independently executes assigned clinical studies activities, applying comprehensive scientific knowledge to clinical data collection, management, quality assessment, analysis support, and documentation. This fully qualified professional-level position independently manages complex clinical imaging datasets, develops and optimizes data collection and processing workflows ensuring data integrity and process efficiency.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Executes assigned components of clinical studies independently managing assigned activities from planning through completion.
Manages the collection, maintenance, and quality of medical imaging data and associated clinical information from multiple clinical sites, ensuring data integrity and completeness.
Develops and implements image collection procedures and protocols in accordance with SOPs, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), FDA regulations, HIPAA, and other applicable requirements.
Collaborates with radiologists and cross-functional teams to establish and maintain ground truth standards for clinical imaging studies.
Assesses image data for quality and protocol compliance, resolves discrepancies, and maintains accurate image databases and tracking systems.
Support data analysis and contributes to interpretation of study results
Develops study documentation, technical reports, and scientific materials independently
Builds productive working relationships with internal teams and collaborates cross-functionally
Provides regular status updates on data collection activities and identifies opportunities to improve data collection, processing, and operational workflows.
Ensures compliance with regulatory, data privacy, and ethical standards
Works independently on assigned problems, applying sound scientific judgment and evaluation


PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Minimum Qualifications, Education And Experience


BS degree and a minimum of 5 years of related experience; or a Master’s degree and 3 years of experience; or equivalent work experience
Knowledge of clinical research principles and data analysis
Proficiency in scientific computing, data analysis tools, and programming
Strong attention to detail, documentation and communication skills
Understanding of statistical methods and their application
Experience working with real-world healthcare data, preferably imaging (dicom) data
Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage assigned tasks to completion


Quality Standards


Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.
Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.
Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.
Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.
Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.
Practices universal safety precautions.
Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.
Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.
Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.
Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.


Travel

This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.

Working Environment

Remote / Office / Hybrid

Physical Demands

This position often requires sitting, standing, walking, bending, twisting, reaching with hands and arms, using hands and fingers, handling, or feeling, speaking, listening, and high-level cognitive thinking. Also, must be able to lift up to 10 pounds occasionally.

Title: Senior Analyst, Data and Analysis
Description:
Company Description

Digitas is the Networked Experience Agency, built on the vision that we create magnetic experiences that earn the right for brands to exist in human networks. Today, and tomorrow. We deliver Networked Experiences by leveraging comprehensive data, technology, creative, media and strategy capabilities. Digitas delivers ambitious outcomes via unique solutions that include Creative Experiences, Integrated Media, Addressable Relationships, Social Marketing and Total Commerce. Celebrated by AdAge as Data and Insights Agency of the Year, U.S Campaign’s Brand Experience Agency of the Year, Media Network of the Year and celebrated by Forrester and Gartner, Digitas serves the world’s leading brands through a global network comprised of more than 5,500 employees across over 65 offices in 43 countries.

The Digitas culture is made up of fearless, inventive and generous Unicorns of all kinds.

Overview

Senior Analyst, Data and Analysis

The Data & Analysis team uses data-driven insights to fuel strategic growth for clients. We believe that data should never exist in a vacuum; instead, it should be put to work to bring the best ideas and stories to our clients.

To help with this, we’re looking for an outstanding Senior Analyst – someone who can analyze massive data sets, make insightful cross-channel recommendations, and communicate strategic ideas to clients. Sound like you? Read on.

As a Senior Analyst, you’ll build the strategic and tactical foundation for data-driven marketing efforts. You’ll work to achieve client goals through brand and acquisition campaigns, site optimization, and/or online testing strategy.

Day-to-day, Your Role Includes


Instituting frameworks across project and campaign lifecycles, including measurement plans, primary and secondary research, and performance reporting
Diving into large data sets, uncovering insights, and providing impactful recommendations to clients
Connecting the dots across channels through data (including display media, site, search, email, and social) to provide a holistic view of marketing efforts
Communicating with clients regularly on scheduled deliverables and ad-hoc requests
Collaborating with internal teams and external partners to drive success for client’s business goals


Qualifications

We’re looking for strong, impactful work experience, which typically includes:


3-5 years of experience in analytics or strategy
A four-year college degree
Passion for digital marketing and emerging trends in the digital landscape
Experience communicating with internal and external stakeholders at a variety of levels
Fluency with Excel (including pivot tables and vlookups) and/or other data analysis tools such as SQL or Tableau
Comfortable in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment
Familiarity with prompt-based interaction and commonly used generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Google Gemini, DALL·E, Midjourney) is a plus, especially for tasks like ideation, research, or content generation.


Got the sparkle? Apply if you believe your unique skills are a fit!

Our Publicis Groupe motto “Viva La Différence” means we’re better together, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. We are focused on fostering belonging and creating equitable & inclusive experiences for all talent.

Title: Customer Experience Analyst
Description:
About SimpliSafe

We're a high-tech home security company that's passionate about protecting the life you've built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we've created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you're building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don't just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.

We're embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state-of-the-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.

Why are we hiring?

Well, we're growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

About The Job

The SimpliSafe CX Analytics team is looking for a Senior Analyst to co-own performance for our rapidly growing Telesales and Loyalty channels — both key strategic priorities for SimpliSafe's future growth. In this role, you won't just measure a team of 150+ agents driving new customer acquisition and subscriber retention — you will help set the strategy that determines whether they succeed.

This is a unique opportunity to build deep, sustained fluency in how Telesales and Loyalty actually operate — and to use that fluency to identify what the business should be doing differently, not just report on what it did. You will define the KPIs that matter, understand what truly drives them, forecast where they're headed, and then support experiments aimed at identifying the right tactics to beat that forecast. You will share accountability for the outcome with Operational leadership, not just for the accuracy of the analysis. Your responsibilities will include:


Own the full KPI lifecycle for Telesales and Loyalty performance: define the right KPIs at the channel and agent level, build and maintain the forecasts for them, and develop a deep understanding of what drives them
Originate and lead experimentation aimed at beating those forecasts — partnering with the business to identify test ideas and ensuring rigorous setup and measurement so the business can trust the read
Get close enough to the operation — the agents, the workflows, the day-to-day realities of Telesales and Loyalty — to spot risks and opportunities Operations can't see from the inside, and bring recommendations to leadership before they ask
Share accountability with Operational leadership for the business results, not just the integrity of the analysis — success is measured by whether Telesales and Loyalty performance improves, not just whether the reporting is right
Serve as data steward for the datasets underlying these KPIs, and use AI tools and automation to eliminate as much manual reporting and one-off analysis as possible — reinvesting that time into the work above


Qualifications:


BS in a quantitative field or equivalent experience (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related field)
5+ years of equivalent experience, or Masters + 3 years
Strong technical skills, including experience with query and data visualization tools. SQL and Excel are core requirements; experience with Tableau, Hex, or programming languages (Python, R, etc.) is a plus
Track record of proposing ideas and driving them to business impact, not just delivering requested analysis — comfortable being judged on whether the business outcome moved, not only on whether the work was correct
Experience designing and running experiments or pilots — including forming the hypothesis, not just measuring someone else's
Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with extreme attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic, cross-functional environment
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize concepts for non-technical audiences and effectively engage partners across all levels of the company
Genuine interest in learning how a complex operation runs day-to-day — willing to spend real time with Ops and agents, not just their data — in order to identify the question behind the question
Comfort using AI tools to accelerate data prep and analysis, so more time goes toward business understanding and origination
Experience supporting contact center operations is a plus


What Values You'll Share


Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.
Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.
No Ego - Maintaining a "no job too small" attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.
One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.
Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.


What We Offer


A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive
A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here)
Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.
Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.


The target annual base pay range for this role is $65,000 to $87,500

This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees' job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.

Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.

We're committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.

We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact careers@simplisafe.com.

At WECTEC Staffing Services, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Westinghouse Electric Company LLC, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace.

Denver, CO-Hybrid


Onsite: Tuesday–Thursday
Remote: Monday & Friday


Position Overview

We are looking for an analytical Data Analyst to support the Gas Capital Portfolio. You will focus on deep data analysis, trend identification, and translating complex datasets into relevant business insights.

Unlike traditional project coordination roles, this position centers on data-driven decision support—applying reporting, analytics, and visualization to help leadership understand performance, identify risks, and guide strategic outcomes.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze data from capital projects and operations to identify trends, variances, and performance insights
Develop dashboards and reports to communicate findings to team members and leadership

Title: Modeling Analyst II
Description:
Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions

The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy’s industry-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real-time trading decisions and mid-to-long-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. It’s both challenging work and work with a purpose.

Be a part of our successful, growing business during international transformation.

Position Summary

As a Modeling Analyst II, you will be the subject matter expert on fundamental market price forecasting within our EnCompass product line. This role plays a critical part in ensuring that EnCompass meets the needs of our customers by providing advanced customer support to current and future customers, supporting product development and documentation, and testing and updating market databases for North America. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in power system modeling including production costing, market price formation, and economic transmission analysis.

This position requires close collaboration with Product Management, Engineering, and Sales to ensure the success of our customers, while also providing customer-facing expertise including day to day customer support, onboarding and training.

Position Details


Salary range: $110,000 - $140,000 plus bonus
Full-time
Hybrid or Remote
Reporting to: Senior Director, Customer Success
Travel requirement: Up to 30%


Primary Responsibilities


Ensure customers know how to use our products to their fullest potential by providing exceptional customer service, answering questions, troubleshooting issues, and providing technical support.
Engage existing and new customers in online and in-person training and onboarding - utilizing presentation skills, industry knowledge, and Yes Energy’s product expertise to maximize our customers’ product use experience.
Update and create product documentation, tutorials, and related materials.
Work closely with Product Management and Engineering to facilitate communication about product issues, user experience and to implement and test new EnCompass features.
Assist Power Infrastructure and partner companies in providing robust EnCompass databases for the North American power markets.
Provide subject matter expertise to Sales and Marketing to develop campaigns and participate in industry events.


Minimum Qualifications


Minimum of three years of experience in power system modeling, including market price forecasting, production costing, economic transmission analysis, and/or resource planning.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, or a related analytical field.
Experience using Excel or BI tools to analyze data.
Excellent communication skills.
Ability to troubleshoot complex modeling errors and guide customers through resolution.
Ability to travel to customer sites to provide in person training, up to 2 times per month.


Preferred Qualifications


Direct experience with EnCompass, PLEXOS, Aurora, or PROMOD models.
Familiarity with FERC regulations, ISO/RTO operations, and resource adequacy constructs.
Prior experience in a client-facing or consultative role, particularly within the energy sector.


At Yes Energy, we value connecting directly with candidates. We kindly ask that third-party recruiters and agencies not submit resumes, as we are not open to external recruiting partnerships.

Overview

ABOUT YES ENERGY

Yes Energy delivers real-time market data and electric power trading decision solutions. Over 1,000 market participants use Yes Energy solutions daily. The client is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Technical Data Analyst to support enterprise data quality, migration, and integration initiatives. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of experience in data analysis, data quality, or data management within enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of data governance, data quality principles, and data lifecycle management.

Experience creating KPIs and visualizations to monitor data quality, migration progress, and operational performance.


Integration & APIs


Experience working with MuleSoft for API-led integrations and enterprise data exchange.

Experience supporting API testing, validation, and troubleshooting.
Familiarity with integrating cloud applications, including CRM platforms such as Salesforce, using APIs.

Experience supporting Salesforce CRM implementations, migrations, or data quality initiatives.
Experience with ETL/data integration tools and enterprise data migration projects.
Familiarity with data quality platforms such as Cloudingo, DemandTools, Informatica, Talend, or similar solutions.

Create and maintain data mapping documents, conversion templates, and validation artifacts.
Build Tableau and Power BI dashboards to monitor data quality, migration readiness, and business metrics.
Support API integrations and data exchange using MuleSoft and REST APIs.

Description:
Company Overview

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

Team Overview

KKR’s Global Operations team enables the firm’s businesses by supporting the lifecycles of our investments, investors, and funds from one global operating platform. Leveraging a data-driven approach, the team’s operating verticals align with our businesses to ensure that we are able to provide best in class service to internal and external stakeholders while using technology, process, and location as tools to adapt and scale. The business area is comprised of the Client Services, Treasury, Private Market Operations, Data Operations, and Global Credit Investment Operations teams.

Position Summary

KKR has an enterprise data operations group to collect, manage, and harness the power of data across our diverse business activities. Given the criticality of Portfolio Company (PortCo) data to KKR’s Private Markets business, a dedicated Portfolio Company Data Operations function has been established to service our Private Equity and Infrastructure businesses. Structured within the broader Global Data Operations organization, this team is tasked with ensuring all Portfolio Company financials are controlled, consumable, and curated to deliver transparent & impactful insights to key internal & external constituents.

The PortCo Data Operations team is seeking to hire an Associate based in Boston, MA to support Americas Private Equity data management and performance reporting/analysis efforts. The candidate will work closely with Private Equity deal teams, KKR Capstone, and KKR Capital Markets teams to lead the KKR internal portfolio monitoring process and associated technology platform. While driving continuous transformation & improvement, this role will also assist with the execution of the on-going processes of Portfolio Company on-boarding, data quality management, and analytics to meet the evolving needs of both regional & global leadership.

This position will report to the Americas Lead, Portfolio Company Data Operations. The ideal candidate would have the unique combination of financial acumen, strong data analysis & technical skills, and a passion/interest in private markets investing. The candidate should also have an interest in embracing new technologies (AI), have strong verbal/written communication skills, and be a good cultural fit with an emphasis on collaboration, excellence, and action-oriented results.

KKR has a very collaborative culture where an individual’s success is the result of both acumen in the role and ability to leverage the whole firm. They think in terms of “we”, not “I” and know we are better together than one single person. One firm, collaboration, operating with “like and trust” are core to how KKR operates. The person who joins in this role is joining the Portfolio Company Data Operations team but also a team of 2,500 people across the firm and we all work together to support each other in delivering the best of KKR to our companies and clients.

RESPONSIBLITIES


Maintain and analyze Americas Private Equity portfolio company financial data, ensuring end-to-end data integrity and a unified source of truth throughout the company lifecycle—including onboarding, operational monitoring, and exit analysis.
Manage the recurring financial data collection efforts for Americas Private Equity, ensuring that data is clean and accurate and operational processes are high quality and repeatable.
Develop and maintain data products, complex SQL and data transformation logic, AI skills and agents, and lightweight software solutions that automate financial analysis and operational workflows.
Produce quarterly performance reporting and analytics across strategies, working closely with deal teams to synthesize financial and operational data to produce actionable insights for portfolio management committees and senior leadership.
Monitor data quality controls to ensure PortCo data completeness & accuracy, helping with the processing of any / all corrective maintenance required to remediate identified data issues in a timely manner.
Operate the internal data platform (Chronograph) within the region, resolving technical and data-related inquiries and leveraging platform to optimize user experience and engagement.
Provide a best-in-class client data experience by producing quarterly LP reports, managing ad hoc data requests, and addressing due diligence queries in collaboration with KKR’s Client Services team.
Act as a trusted resource for data-related questions and updates from various internal and external groups, such as PortCo contacts and deal teams.
Collaborate with the Global Data Operations team, to provide flexible support to all data initiatives and global functions, as necessary.
Collaborate with regional team members across offices and time zones in support of these initiatives.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Engineering, Analytics, Information Systems, or related quantitative discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
4-6 years of experience in a data-intensive role within financial services, private equity, asset management, or a comparable institutional environment.
Intermediate SQL skills to manipulate data (experience with joins, unions, views, etc.).
Familiarity with Python or a similar programming language.
Understanding of financial statement analysis, corporate finance, and the private equity ecosystem.
Hands-on experience using data visualization tools such as Sigma, PowerBI, Tableau, or similar tools to support analyses.
Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, Excel plug ins, Power Query).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill data into insights.
Strong cultural fit – collaborative, intellectually curious, action-oriented, and committed to high standards of excellence and accountability.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment, including ability to be detail-oriented across multiple competing priorities.


Preferred Qualifications


Buy-side exposure with experience in asset/ investment management.
Data analytics & modeling skills using Python, R, etc.
Experience with cloud data warehouse solutions such as Snowflake, Databricks, etc.
Experience with Private Equity Portfolio Monitoring tools such as Chronograph, iLEVEL, Cobalt, etc.
Knowledge of Private Markets / Private Company data, trends and analytics.
Familiarity with market & alternative data vendors.


This is the expected annual base salary range for this Boston-based position. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.

$90,000—$130,000 USD

Lead data governance, quality, security, and privacy practices while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and internal standards.
Build and scale a high-performing data organization across data science, analytics engineering, and machine learning functions.

Strong hands-on expertise in machine learning and AI, including experience designing, training, evaluating, and improving models.
Demonstrated experience creating and managing A/B testing or experimentation frameworks to support data-driven decisions.
Proven ability to translate data strategies into measurable business outcomes, ideally connected to revenue growth, customer value, or monetization improvements.
Deep understanding of modern data architecture, cloud data platforms, pipelines, MLOps, and enterprise data infrastructure.
Experience establishing data governance, security, privacy, and compliance frameworks.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, leadership teams, and cross-functional partners.

Title: Data Specialist (Remote)
Description:
Role: Data Specialist (Remote)
Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
Job Type: Full-Time
Payout: Competitive, based on experience




Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Human Data Manager, New Grad to work on a full-time basis. The role involves maintaining high-quality datasets used in AI model training and evaluation, ensuring accuracy and relevance of labeled information. Candidates will assist in refining data pipelines and improving annotation processes for machine learning applications.




Key Responsibilities:

• Review and validate human-labeled data to ensure consistency and accuracy for AI training datasets

• Identify and resolve discrepancies in data annotations by cross-referencing source materials and guidelines

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine annotation guidelines and improve data quality standards

• Monitor and report on data labeling performance metrics to track progress and identify trends

• Assist in documenting processes and maintaining records of data sources, labeling rules, and quality checks

• Experience with data annotation, labeling, or quality assurance processes is preferred

• Familiarity with basic data validation techniques and attention to detail in reviewing datasets

• Ability to follow structured guidelines and maintain consistency in data handling tasks

• Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and their dependence on high-quality training data is beneficial

• Proficiency in using spreadsheets or data management tools to track and organize information

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Technology, Information and Internet industry, contributing to the development of reliable AI systems through precise data management. The position provides exposure to real-world applications of data in machine learning workflows.

Title: Assistant General Manager
Description:
About us







Zara offers the latest fashion trends for all. An international brand with stores in the main cities of the world and online. Our business model is centered in our customers, constantly adapting to their needs. We love what we do. Teamwork, passion, curiosity, diversity, sustainability, creativity and humility are our daily motivation. Does it sound like you? Maybe you are a Zara person.




Purpose




As the second person in charge of the store, together with the director, you are the global figures in the store. You will support managers by leading the team to achieve the store's objectives while meeting the company's management standards and ensuring a good customer experience. You’ll have a global vision of the business and link between the three key parts: product, operations and people. As a team leader and inspirer, with knowledge of fashion and product. You will also have strong organizational and planning skills; as well as being analytical, with the ability to interpret reports from all areas of the store (product, operations, people), draw conclusions and implement improvements. In addition to being innovative, with a great capacity to adapt and lead change.







Key Responsibilities:







PRODUCT







Supports the director in managing all sections to achieve sales targets.
Monitor product display in all sections.
Ensure that in all sections product analysis is carried out (shortcomings, competition and trends) to carry out the different actions and thus achieve better results.
Commercial analysis to execute actions that improve sales (Retail, Business Map, product reports, Teams communications).
Continuous communication and feedback is given to both the central and the country sales team.
Monitor the communication flow of all departments.




PROCESS







Support the director in the management of warehouse stock and merchandise flows, taking into account the criteria of the Commercial Manager.
Support the director by executing the organization and planning of people and processes.
Ensure that teams work to company standards achieving appropriate productivity.
Supervise the operation of the store devices and ensure that the technological part works well and provides a good shopping experience.
Support management team by ensuring compliance with omnichannel-related processes (SINT, IPOD, STORE MODE, CC).
Lead the implementations of new projects and commercial and operational updates.
Responsible for and ensure that SHRINKAGE is minimized and coordinate action plans regarding the needs of the store.




CUSTOMER







Lead the standards of customer service in your store.
Ensures that incidents are resolved in time.




PEOPLE







Help the manager manage the budget of hours with respect to the needs of the store.
Execute the process of preparing schedules in all sections and ensure coverage appropriate to the sales dynamics and operational workload of the store.
Supervise all types of training (on-boarding, mandatory training on the Tra!n platform, job training, etc.)
Support the director in the development of succession plans (quarry) by identifying and training potential candidates.
Develop, recognize, and give constructive feedback.
Leads compliance with occupational risk prevention, health and safety at work standards.







What we offer:







In addition to a competitive salary, you will also receive 25% discount to buy the latest trends in any of our brands and a variety benefit package where you can find a wide range of discounts.

Our internal talent is our greatest asset and we are proud of offering internal promotion programs where you will find opportunities to grow, e-learning and training programs as well as social projects to get involved and contribute to a better society, and much more!




Annual compensation range:




$84,000 - $95,760 + discretionary bonus

Actual compensation within that range will be dependent upon the individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable laws.
